      rootValid, valid, enough => by
      simp only [encodeChunkNode] at encoded
      cases keyResult : maximumChunkRowid? left with
      | none => simp [keyResult] at encoded
      | some key =>
          simp only [keyResult, Option.bind_eq_bind, Option.bind] at encoded
          cases rootResult : RecursivePageBTree.interiorPage?
              [(left.rootId, key)] right.rootId with
          | none => simp [rootResult] at encoded
          | some root =>
              simp only [rootResult] at encoded
              cases leftResult : encodeChunkNode schema left with
              | none => simp [leftResult] at encoded
              | some leftPages =>
                  simp only [leftResult] at encoded
                  cases rightResult : encodeChunkNode schema right with
                  | none => simp [rightResult] at encoded
                  | some rightPages =>
                      simp only [rightResult, Option.some.injEq] at encoded
                      subst pages
                      cases fuel with
                      | zero => simp [PersistentPageTree.Node.erase,
                          RecursiveBPlusTree.Node.height] at enough
                      | succ childFuel =>
                          have rootRead : source.readPage pageId =
                              some root.bytes :=
                            contains ⟨pageId, root⟩ (by simp)
                          have leftContains :
                              PageSourceContains source leftPages := by
                            intro numbered member
                            exact contains numbered (by simp [member])
                          have rightContains :
                              PageSourceContains source rightPages := by
                            intro numbered member
                            exact contains numbered (by simp [member])
                          rcases rootValid with
                            ⟨leftValid, rightValid, heights, _, _⟩
                          have leftRowsValid : ∀ entry ∈ left.erase.toList,
                              ∀ row ∈ entry.2, row.WellFormed schema := by
                            intro entry member row rowMember
                            exact valid entry (by
                              simp only [PersistentPageTree.Node.erase,
                                RecursiveBPlusTree.Node.toList,
                                List.mem_append]
                              exact Or.inl member) row rowMember
                          have rightRowsValid : ∀ entry ∈ right.erase.toList,
                              ∀ row ∈ entry.2, row.WellFormed schema := by
                            intro entry member row rowMember
                            exact valid entry (by
                              simp only [PersistentPageTree.Node.erase,
                                RecursiveBPlusTree.Node.toList,
                                List.mem_append]
                              exact Or.inr member) row rowMember
                          have leftDecoded :=
                            decodeSubtreeRowsFrom_encodeChunkNode schema source
                              left leftPages childFuel leftResult leftContains
                              leftValid.rootValid leftRowsValid (by
                                simp [PersistentPageTree.Node.erase,
                                  RecursiveBPlusTree.Node.height] at enough
                                omega)
                          have rightDecoded :=
                            decodeSubtreeRowsFrom_encodeChunkNode schema source
                              right rightPages childFuel rightResult rightContains
                              rightValid.rootValid rightRowsValid (by
                                simp [PersistentPageTree.Node.erase,
                                  RecursiveBPlusTree.Node.height] at enough
                                omega)
                          unfold CoreDecode.decodeSubtreeRowsFrom
                          simp only [PersistentPageTree.Node.rootId]
                          rw [rootRead]
                          simp only [Option.bind_eq_bind, Option.bind]
                          rw [interiorChildren_interiorPage_one rootResult]
                          simp [leftDecoded, rightDecoded,
                            CoreChunkPageState.Node.rows,
                            PersistentPageTree.Node.erase,
                            RecursiveBPlusTree.Node.toList]
  | .branch3 pageId left firstSeparator middle secondSeparator right,
      pages, fuel, encoded, contains, rootValid, valid, enough => by
      simp only [encodeChunkNode] at encoded
      cases leftKeyResult : maximumChunkRowid? left with
      | none => simp [leftKeyResult] at encoded
      | some leftKey =>
          simp only [leftKeyResult, Option.bind_eq_bind, Option.bind] at encoded
          cases middleKeyResult : maximumChunkRowid? middle with
          | none => simp [middleKeyResult] at encoded
          | some middleKey =>
              simp only [middleKeyResult] at encoded
              cases rootResult : RecursivePageBTree.interiorPage?
                  [(left.rootId, leftKey), (middle.rootId, middleKey)]
                    right.rootId with
              | none => simp [rootResult] at encoded
              | some root =>
                  simp only [rootResult] at encoded
                  cases leftResult : encodeChunkNode schema left with
                  | none => simp [leftResult] at encoded
                  | some leftPages =>
                      simp only [leftResult] at encoded
                      cases middleResult : encodeChunkNode schema middle with
                      | none => simp [middleResult] at encoded
                      | some middlePages =>
                          simp only [middleResult] at encoded
                          cases rightResult : encodeChunkNode schema right with
                          | none => simp [rightResult] at encoded
                          | some rightPages =>
                              simp only [rightResult, Option.some.injEq] at encoded
                              subst pages
                              cases fuel with
                              | zero => simp [PersistentPageTree.Node.erase,
                                  RecursiveBPlusTree.Node.height] at enough
                              | succ childFuel =>
                                  have rootRead : source.readPage pageId =
                                      some root.bytes :=
                                    contains ⟨pageId, root⟩ (by simp)
                                  have leftContains :
                                      PageSourceContains source leftPages := by
                                    intro numbered member
                                    exact contains numbered (by simp [member])
                                  have middleContains :
                                      PageSourceContains source middlePages := by
                                    intro numbered member
                                    exact contains numbered (by simp [member])
                                  have rightContains :
                                      PageSourceContains source rightPages := by
                                    intro numbered member
                                    exact contains numbered (by simp [member])
                                  rcases rootValid with
                                    ⟨leftValid, middleValid, rightValid,
                                      leftHeight, rightHeight, _, _, _, _⟩
                                  have leftRowsValid :
                                      ∀ entry ∈ left.erase.toList,
                                        ∀ row ∈ entry.2,
                                          row.WellFormed schema := by
                                    intro entry member row rowMember
                                    exact valid entry (by
                                      simp only [PersistentPageTree.Node.erase,
                                        RecursiveBPlusTree.Node.toList,
                                        List.mem_append]
                                      exact Or.inl (Or.inl member)) row rowMember
                                  have middleRowsValid :
                                      ∀ entry ∈ middle.erase.toList,
                                        ∀ row ∈ entry.2,
                                          row.WellFormed schema := by
                                    intro entry member row rowMember
                                    exact valid entry (by
                                      simp only [PersistentPageTree.Node.erase,
                                        RecursiveBPlusTree.Node.toList,
                                        List.mem_append]
                                      exact Or.inl (Or.inr member)) row rowMember
                                  have rightRowsValid :
                                      ∀ entry ∈ right.erase.toList,
                                        ∀ row ∈ entry.2,
                                          row.WellFormed schema := by
                                    intro entry member row rowMember
                                    exact valid entry (by
                                      simp only [PersistentPageTree.Node.erase,
                                        RecursiveBPlusTree.Node.toList,
                                        List.mem_append]
                                      exact Or.inr member) row rowMember
                                  have leftDecoded :=
                                    decodeSubtreeRowsFrom_encodeChunkNode schema
                                      source left leftPages childFuel leftResult
                                      leftContains
                                      leftValid.rootValid
                                      leftRowsValid (by
                                          simp [PersistentPageTree.Node.erase,
                                            RecursiveBPlusTree.Node.height]
                                              at enough
                                          omega)
                                  have middleDecoded :=
                                    decodeSubtreeRowsFrom_encodeChunkNode schema
                                      source middle middlePages childFuel
                                      middleResult middleContains
                                      middleValid.rootValid
                                      middleRowsValid (by
                                          simp [PersistentPageTree.Node.erase,
                                            RecursiveBPlusTree.Node.height]
                                              at enough
                                          omega)
                                  have rightDecoded :=
                                    decodeSubtreeRowsFrom_encodeChunkNode schema
                                      source right rightPages childFuel rightResult
                                      rightContains
                                      rightValid.rootValid
                                      rightRowsValid (by
                                          simp [PersistentPageTree.Node.erase,
                                            RecursiveBPlusTree.Node.height]
                                              at enough
                                          omega)
                                  unfold CoreDecode.decodeSubtreeRowsFrom
                                  simp only [PersistentPageTree.Node.rootId]
                                  rw [rootRead]
                                  simp only [Option.bind_eq_bind, Option.bind]
                                  rw [interiorChildren_interiorPage_two rootResult]
                                  simp [leftDecoded, middleDecoded, rightDecoded,
                                    CoreChunkPageState.Node.rows,
                                    PersistentPageTree.Node.erase,
                                    RecursiveBPlusTree.Node.toList]

/-- Exact raw-page point lookup for every table tree emitted by the persistent
encoder.  It covers successful hits and valid misses: the result is precisely
the rowid search of the tree abstraction, while acquiring one child per level. -/
theorem lookupTableRowidFrom_encodeChunkNode (schema : Core.Schema)
    (source : CoreDecode.PageSource) (target : Core.Integer) :
    ∀ (node : PersistentPageTree.Node CoreChunkPageState.Chunk)
      (pages : List NumberedPage) (fuel : Nat),
      encodeChunkNode schema node = some pages →
      PageSourceContains source pages →
      node.erase.RootValid →
      (∀ entry ∈ node.erase.toList, ∀ row ∈ entry.2,
        row.WellFormed schema) →
      (∀ pageId ∈ node.pageIds, 0 < pageId) →
      (CoreChunkPageState.Node.rows node).Pairwise Core.Row.keyLess →
      node.erase.height < fuel →
      CoreDecode.lookupTableRowidFrom schema source target fuel node.rootId =
        some ((CoreChunkPageState.Node.rows node).find?
          fun row => row.rowid = target)
  | .leaf pageId entries, pages, fuel, encoded, contains, _, valid, _, _,
      enough => by
      simp only [encodeChunkNode] at encoded
      cases pageResult : encodeChunkLeaf schema entries with
      | none => simp [pageResult] at encoded
      | some page =>
          simp only [pageResult, Option.bind_eq_bind, Option.bind,
            Option.some.injEq] at encoded
          subst pages
          cases fuel with
          | zero => simp [PersistentPageTree.Node.erase,
              RecursiveBPlusTree.Node.height] at enough
          | succ childFuel =>
              rw [CoreDecode.lookupTableRowidFrom_succ]
              simp only [PersistentPageTree.Node.rootId]
              rw [contains ⟨pageId, page⟩ (by simp)]
              simp only [decodeTableInterior_encodeChunkLeaf schema entries
                page pageResult]
              rw [decodeRowsFrom_encodeChunkLeaf schema entries page
                (fun entry member row rowMember =>
                  valid entry (by simpa using member) row rowMember)
                pageResult source]
              rfl
  | .branch2 pageId left separator right, pages, fuel, encoded, contains,
      rootValid, valid, positive, ordered, enough => by
      simp only [encodeChunkNode] at encoded
      cases keyResult : maximumChunkRowid? left with
      | none => simp [keyResult] at encoded
      | some key =>
          simp only [keyResult, Option.bind_eq_bind, Option.bind] at encoded
          cases rootResult : RecursivePageBTree.interiorPage?
              [(left.rootId, key)] right.rootId with
          | none => simp [rootResult] at encoded
          | some root =>
              simp only [rootResult] at encoded
              cases leftResult : encodeChunkNode schema left with
              | none => simp [leftResult] at encoded
              | some leftPages =>
                  simp only [leftResult] at encoded
                  cases rightResult : encodeChunkNode schema right with
                  | none => simp [rightResult] at encoded
                  | some rightPages =>
                      simp only [rightResult, Option.some.injEq] at encoded
                      subst pages
                      cases fuel with
                      | zero => simp [PersistentPageTree.Node.erase,
                          RecursiveBPlusTree.Node.height] at enough
                      | succ childFuel =>
                          have rootRead : source.readPage pageId =
                              some root.bytes :=
                            contains ⟨pageId, root⟩ (by simp)
                          have leftContains :
                              PageSourceContains source leftPages := by
                            intro numbered member
                            exact contains numbered (by simp [member])
                          have rightContains :
                              PageSourceContains source rightPages := by
                            intro numbered member
                            exact contains numbered (by simp [member])
                          rcases rootValid with
                            ⟨leftValid, rightValid, heights, _, _⟩
                          have leftRowsValid : ∀ entry ∈ left.erase.toList,
                              ∀ row ∈ entry.2, row.WellFormed schema := by
                            intro entry member row rowMember
                            exact valid entry (by
                              simp only [PersistentPageTree.Node.erase,
                                RecursiveBPlusTree.Node.toList,
                                List.mem_append]
                              exact Or.inl member) row rowMember
                          have rightRowsValid : ∀ entry ∈ right.erase.toList,
                              ∀ row ∈ entry.2, row.WellFormed schema := by
                            intro entry member row rowMember
                            exact valid entry (by
                              simp only [PersistentPageTree.Node.erase,
                                RecursiveBPlusTree.Node.toList,
                                List.mem_append]
                              exact Or.inr member) row rowMember
                          have leftPositive : ∀ id ∈ left.pageIds, 0 < id := by
                            intro id member
                            apply positive id
                            simp only [PersistentPageTree.Node.pageIds,
                              List.mem_cons, List.mem_append]
                            exact Or.inl (Or.inr member)
                          have rightPositive : ∀ id ∈ right.pageIds, 0 < id := by
                            intro id member
                            apply positive id
                            simp only [PersistentPageTree.Node.pageIds,
                              List.mem_cons, List.mem_append]
                            exact Or.inr member
                          have childrenOrdered :
                              (CoreChunkPageState.Node.rows left ++
                                CoreChunkPageState.Node.rows right).Pairwise
                                  Core.Row.keyLess := by
                            simpa [CoreChunkPageState.Node.rows,
                              PersistentPageTree.Node.erase,
                              RecursiveBPlusTree.Node.toList,
                              List.flatMap_append] using ordered
                          have leftLookup :=
                            lookupTableRowidFrom_encodeChunkNode schema source
                              target left leftPages childFuel leftResult
                              leftContains leftValid.rootValid leftRowsValid
                              leftPositive
                              (List.pairwise_append.mp childrenOrdered).1 (by
                                simp [PersistentPageTree.Node.erase,
                                  RecursiveBPlusTree.Node.height] at enough
                                omega)
                          have rightLookup :=
                            lookupTableRowidFrom_encodeChunkNode schema source
                              target right rightPages childFuel rightResult
                              rightContains rightValid.rootValid rightRowsValid
                              rightPositive
                              (List.pairwise_append.mp childrenOrdered).2.1 (by
                                simp [PersistentPageTree.Node.erase,
                                  RecursiveBPlusTree.Node.height] at enough
                                omega)
                          rcases maximumChunkRowid?_witness keyResult with
                            ⟨boundary, boundaryLast, rfl⟩
                          have keyBound : boundary.rowid.toUnsigned < 2 ^ 64 := by
                            simpa [FileFormat.IntegerWidth.modulus] using
                              boundary.rowid.toUnsigned_lt
                          have leftRootPositive : 0 < left.rootId :=
                            leftPositive left.rootId left.rootId_mem_pageIds
                          have routing := findRowid_append_routed target
                            boundary.rowid
                            (CoreChunkPageState.Node.rows left)
                            (CoreChunkPageState.Node.rows right)
                            childrenOrdered (by rw [boundaryLast]; rfl)
                          rw [CoreDecode.lookupTableRowidFrom_succ]
                          simp only [PersistentPageTree.Node.rootId]
                          rw [rootRead]
                          simp only [decodeTableInterior_interiorPage_one
                            leftRootPositive keyBound rootResult]
                          rw [FileFormat.signedIntegerFromUnsigned_toUnsigned]
                          by_cases routed :
                              target.value ≤ boundary.rowid.value
                          · have findEqual : findRowid target
                                (CoreChunkPageState.Node.rows left ++
                                  CoreChunkPageState.Node.rows right) =
                                findRowid target
                                  (CoreChunkPageState.Node.rows left) := by
                              simpa [routed] using routing
                            simpa [CoreDecode.tableChildForRowid, routed,
                              leftLookup, findRowid,
                              CoreChunkPageState.Node.rows,
                              PersistentPageTree.Node.erase,
                              RecursiveBPlusTree.Node.toList,
                              List.flatMap_append] using congrArg some
                                findEqual.symm
                          · have findEqual : findRowid target
                                (CoreChunkPageState.Node.rows left ++
                                  CoreChunkPageState.Node.rows right) =
                                findRowid target
                                  (CoreChunkPageState.Node.rows right) := by
                              simpa [routed] using routing
                            simpa [CoreDecode.tableChildForRowid, routed,
                              rightLookup, findRowid,
                              CoreChunkPageState.Node.rows,
                              PersistentPageTree.Node.erase,
                              RecursiveBPlusTree.Node.toList,
                              List.flatMap_append] using congrArg some
                                findEqual.symm
  | .branch3 pageId left firstSeparator middle secondSeparator right, pages,
      fuel, encoded, contains, rootValid, valid, positive, ordered, enough => by
      simp only [encodeChunkNode] at encoded
      cases leftKeyResult : maximumChunkRowid? left with
      | none => simp [leftKeyResult] at encoded
      | some leftKey =>
          simp only [leftKeyResult, Option.bind_eq_bind, Option.bind] at encoded
          cases middleKeyResult : maximumChunkRowid? middle with
          | none => simp [middleKeyResult] at encoded
          | some middleKey =>
              simp only [middleKeyResult] at encoded
              cases rootResult : RecursivePageBTree.interiorPage?
                  [(left.rootId, leftKey), (middle.rootId, middleKey)]
                    right.rootId with
              | none => simp [rootResult] at encoded
              | some root =>
                  simp only [rootResult] at encoded
                  cases leftResult : encodeChunkNode schema left with
                  | none => simp [leftResult] at encoded
                  | some leftPages =>
                      simp only [leftResult] at encoded
                      cases middleResult : encodeChunkNode schema middle with
                      | none => simp [middleResult] at encoded
                      | some middlePages =>
                          simp only [middleResult] at encoded
                          cases rightResult : encodeChunkNode schema right with
                          | none => simp [rightResult] at encoded
                          | some rightPages =>
                              simp only [rightResult, Option.some.injEq] at encoded
                              subst pages
                              cases fuel with
                              | zero => simp [PersistentPageTree.Node.erase,
                                  RecursiveBPlusTree.Node.height] at enough
                              | succ childFuel =>
                                  have rootRead : source.readPage pageId =
                                      some root.bytes :=
                                    contains ⟨pageId, root⟩ (by simp)
                                  have leftContains : PageSourceContains source
                                      leftPages := by
                                    intro numbered member
                                    exact contains numbered (by simp [member])
                                  have middleContains : PageSourceContains source
                                      middlePages := by
                                    intro numbered member
                                    exact contains numbered (by simp [member])
                                  have rightContains : PageSourceContains source
                                      rightPages := by
                                    intro numbered member
                                    exact contains numbered (by simp [member])
                                  rcases rootValid with
                                    ⟨leftValid, middleValid, rightValid,
                                      leftHeight, rightHeight, _, _, _, _⟩
                                  have leftRowsValid : ∀ entry ∈ left.erase.toList,
                                      ∀ row ∈ entry.2, row.WellFormed schema := by
                                    intro entry member row rowMember
                                    exact valid entry (by
                                      simp only [PersistentPageTree.Node.erase,
                                        RecursiveBPlusTree.Node.toList,
                                        List.mem_append]
                                      exact Or.inl (Or.inl member)) row rowMember
                                  have middleRowsValid :
                                      ∀ entry ∈ middle.erase.toList,
                                        ∀ row ∈ entry.2,
                                          row.WellFormed schema := by
                                    intro entry member row rowMember
                                    exact valid entry (by
                                      simp only [PersistentPageTree.Node.erase,
                                        RecursiveBPlusTree.Node.toList,
                                        List.mem_append]
                                      exact Or.inl (Or.inr member)) row rowMember
                                  have rightRowsValid :
                                      ∀ entry ∈ right.erase.toList,
                                        ∀ row ∈ entry.2,
                                          row.WellFormed schema := by
                                    intro entry member row rowMember
                                    exact valid entry (by
                                      simp only [PersistentPageTree.Node.erase,
                                        RecursiveBPlusTree.Node.toList,
                                        List.mem_append]
                                      exact Or.inr member) row rowMember
                                  have leftPositive :
                                      ∀ id ∈ left.pageIds, 0 < id := by
                                    intro id member
                                    apply positive id
                                    simp only [PersistentPageTree.Node.pageIds,
                                      List.mem_cons, List.mem_append]
                                    exact Or.inl (Or.inl (Or.inr member))
                                  have middlePositive :
                                      ∀ id ∈ middle.pageIds, 0 < id := by
                                    intro id member
                                    apply positive id
                                    simp only [PersistentPageTree.Node.pageIds,
                                      List.mem_cons, List.mem_append]
                                    exact Or.inl (Or.inr member)
                                  have rightPositive :
                                      ∀ id ∈ right.pageIds, 0 < id := by
                                    intro id member
                                    apply positive id
                                    simp only [PersistentPageTree.Node.pageIds,
                                      List.mem_cons, List.mem_append]
                                    exact Or.inr member
                                  have childrenOrdered :
                                      (CoreChunkPageState.Node.rows left ++
                                        CoreChunkPageState.Node.rows middle ++
                                        CoreChunkPageState.Node.rows right).Pairwise
                                          Core.Row.keyLess := by
                                    simpa [CoreChunkPageState.Node.rows,
                                      PersistentPageTree.Node.erase,
                                      RecursiveBPlusTree.Node.toList,
                                      List.flatMap_append,
                                      List.append_assoc] using ordered
                                  have firstSplit :=
                                    List.pairwise_append.mp (show
                                      (CoreChunkPageState.Node.rows left ++
                                        (CoreChunkPageState.Node.rows middle ++
                                          CoreChunkPageState.Node.rows right)).Pairwise
                                            Core.Row.keyLess from by
                                        simpa only [List.append_assoc] using
                                          childrenOrdered)
                                  have middleRightOrdered :
                                      (CoreChunkPageState.Node.rows middle ++
                                        CoreChunkPageState.Node.rows right).Pairwise
                                          Core.Row.keyLess := by
                                    exact firstSplit.2.1
                                  have secondSplit :=
                                    List.pairwise_append.mp middleRightOrdered
                                  have leftLookup :=
                                    lookupTableRowidFrom_encodeChunkNode schema
                                      source target left leftPages childFuel
                                      leftResult leftContains
                                      leftValid.rootValid leftRowsValid
                                      leftPositive firstSplit.1 (by
                                        simp [PersistentPageTree.Node.erase,
                                          RecursiveBPlusTree.Node.height] at enough
                                        omega)
                                  have middleLookup :=
                                    lookupTableRowidFrom_encodeChunkNode schema
                                      source target middle middlePages childFuel
                                      middleResult middleContains
                                      middleValid.rootValid middleRowsValid
                                      middlePositive secondSplit.1 (by
                                        simp [PersistentPageTree.Node.erase,
                                          RecursiveBPlusTree.Node.height] at enough
                                        omega)
                                  have rightLookup :=
                                    lookupTableRowidFrom_encodeChunkNode schema
                                      source target right rightPages childFuel
                                      rightResult rightContains
                                      rightValid.rootValid rightRowsValid
                                      rightPositive secondSplit.2.1 (by
                                        simp [PersistentPageTree.Node.erase,
                                          RecursiveBPlusTree.Node.height] at enough
                                        omega)
                                  rcases maximumChunkRowid?_witness leftKeyResult
                                    with ⟨leftBoundary, leftLast, rfl⟩
                                  rcases maximumChunkRowid?_witness middleKeyResult
                                    with ⟨middleBoundary, middleLast, rfl⟩
                                  have leftKeyBound :
                                      leftBoundary.rowid.toUnsigned < 2 ^ 64 := by
                                    simpa [FileFormat.IntegerWidth.modulus] using
                                      leftBoundary.rowid.toUnsigned_lt
                                  have middleKeyBound :
                                      middleBoundary.rowid.toUnsigned < 2 ^ 64 := by
                                    simpa [FileFormat.IntegerWidth.modulus] using
                                      middleBoundary.rowid.toUnsigned_lt
                                  have leftRootPositive : 0 < left.rootId :=
                                    leftPositive left.rootId
                                      left.rootId_mem_pageIds
                                  have middleRootPositive : 0 < middle.rootId :=
                                    middlePositive middle.rootId
                                      middle.rootId_mem_pageIds
                                  have firstRouting := findRowid_append_routed
                                    target leftBoundary.rowid
                                    (CoreChunkPageState.Node.rows left)
                                    (CoreChunkPageState.Node.rows middle ++
                                      CoreChunkPageState.Node.rows right)
                                    (show (CoreChunkPageState.Node.rows left ++
                                      (CoreChunkPageState.Node.rows middle ++
                                        CoreChunkPageState.Node.rows right)).Pairwise
                                          Core.Row.keyLess from by
                                      simpa only [List.append_assoc] using
                                        childrenOrdered)
                                    (by rw [leftLast]; rfl)
                                  have secondRouting := findRowid_append_routed
                                    target middleBoundary.rowid
                                    (CoreChunkPageState.Node.rows middle)
                                    (CoreChunkPageState.Node.rows right)
                                    middleRightOrdered (by rw [middleLast]; rfl)
                                  rw [CoreDecode.lookupTableRowidFrom_succ]
                                  simp only [PersistentPageTree.Node.rootId]
                                  rw [rootRead]
                                  simp only [decodeTableInterior_interiorPage_two
                                    leftRootPositive middleRootPositive
                                    leftKeyBound middleKeyBound rootResult]
                                  simp only [FileFormat.signedIntegerFromUnsigned_toUnsigned]
                                  by_cases leftRoute :
                                      target.value ≤ leftBoundary.rowid.value
                                  · have findEqual : findRowid target
                                        (CoreChunkPageState.Node.rows left ++
                                          CoreChunkPageState.Node.rows middle ++
                                          CoreChunkPageState.Node.rows right) =
                                        findRowid target
                                          (CoreChunkPageState.Node.rows left) := by
                                      simpa [leftRoute, List.append_assoc] using
                                        firstRouting
                                    simpa [CoreDecode.tableChildForRowid,
                                      leftRoute, leftLookup, findRowid,
                                      CoreChunkPageState.Node.rows,
                                      PersistentPageTree.Node.erase,
                                      RecursiveBPlusTree.Node.toList,
                                      List.flatMap_append,
                                      List.append_assoc] using congrArg some
                                        findEqual.symm
                                  · by_cases middleRoute :
                                        target.value ≤ middleBoundary.rowid.value
                                    · have firstEqual : findRowid target
                                          (CoreChunkPageState.Node.rows left ++
                                            (CoreChunkPageState.Node.rows middle ++
                                              CoreChunkPageState.Node.rows right)) =
                                          findRowid target
                                            (CoreChunkPageState.Node.rows middle ++
                                              CoreChunkPageState.Node.rows right) := by
                                        simpa [leftRoute] using firstRouting
                                      have secondEqual : findRowid target
                                          (CoreChunkPageState.Node.rows middle ++
                                            CoreChunkPageState.Node.rows right) =
                                          findRowid target
                                            (CoreChunkPageState.Node.rows middle) := by
                                        simpa [middleRoute] using secondRouting
                                      have findEqual := firstEqual.trans secondEqual
                                      simpa [CoreDecode.tableChildForRowid,
                                        leftRoute, middleRoute, middleLookup,
                                        findRowid, CoreChunkPageState.Node.rows,
                                        PersistentPageTree.Node.erase,
                                        RecursiveBPlusTree.Node.toList,
                                        List.flatMap_append,
                                        List.append_assoc] using congrArg some
                                          findEqual.symm
                                    · have firstEqual : findRowid target
                                          (CoreChunkPageState.Node.rows left ++
                                            (CoreChunkPageState.Node.rows middle ++
                                              CoreChunkPageState.Node.rows right)) =
                                          findRowid target
                                            (CoreChunkPageState.Node.rows middle ++
                                              CoreChunkPageState.Node.rows right) := by
                                        simpa [leftRoute] using firstRouting
                                      have secondEqual : findRowid target
                                          (CoreChunkPageState.Node.rows middle ++
                                            CoreChunkPageState.Node.rows right) =
                                          findRowid target
                                            (CoreChunkPageState.Node.rows right) := by
                                        simpa [middleRoute] using secondRouting
                                      have findEqual := firstEqual.trans secondEqual
                                      simpa [CoreDecode.tableChildForRowid,
                                        leftRoute, middleRoute, rightLookup,
                                        findRowid, CoreChunkPageState.Node.rows,
                                        PersistentPageTree.Node.erase,
                                        RecursiveBPlusTree.Node.toList,
                                        List.flatMap_append,
                                        List.append_assoc] using congrArg some
                                          findEqual.symm
-/

theorem interiorChildren_encodeChunkRoot_branch2 (schema : Core.Schema)
    (pageId : Nat) (left : PersistentPageTree.Node CoreChunkPageState.Chunk)
    (separator : Nat)
    (right : PersistentPageTree.Node CoreChunkPageState.Chunk)
    (root : NumberedPage)
    (built : encodeChunkRoot schema
      (.branch2 pageId left separator right) = some root) :
    CoreDecode.interiorChildren? root.page.bytes =
      some [left.rootId, right.rootId] := by
  simp only [encodeChunkRoot] at built
  cases keyResult : maximumChunkRowid? left with
  | none => simp [keyResult] at built
  | some key =>
    simp only [keyResult, Option.bind_eq_bind, Option.bind] at built
    cases pageResult : RecursivePageBTree.interiorPage?
        [(left.rootId, key)] right.rootId with
    | none => simp [pageResult] at built
    | some page =>
      simp only [pageResult, Option.some.injEq] at built
      subst root
      exact interiorChildren_interiorPage_one pageResult

theorem interiorChildren_encodeChunkRoot_branch3 (schema : Core.Schema)
    (pageId : Nat) (left : PersistentPageTree.Node CoreChunkPageState.Chunk)
    (firstSeparator : Nat)
    (middle : PersistentPageTree.Node CoreChunkPageState.Chunk)
    (secondSeparator : Nat)
    (right : PersistentPageTree.Node CoreChunkPageState.Chunk)
    (root : NumberedPage)
    (built : encodeChunkRoot schema
      (.branch3 pageId left firstSeparator middle secondSeparator right) =
        some root) :
    CoreDecode.interiorChildren? root.page.bytes =
      some [left.rootId, middle.rootId, right.rootId] := by
  simp only [encodeChunkRoot] at built
  cases leftResult : maximumChunkRowid? left with
  | none => simp [leftResult] at built
  | some leftKey =>
    simp only [leftResult, Option.bind_eq_bind, Option.bind] at built
    cases middleResult : maximumChunkRowid? middle with
    | none => simp [middleResult] at built
    | some middleKey =>
      simp only [middleResult] at built
      cases pageResult : RecursivePageBTree.interiorPage?
          [(left.rootId, leftKey), (middle.rootId, middleKey)] right.rootId with
      | none => simp [pageResult] at built
      | some page =>
        simp only [pageResult, Option.some.injEq] at built
        subst root
        exact interiorChildren_interiorPage_two pageResult

def encodeChunkPath (schema : Core.Schema) (key : Nat) :
    PersistentPageTree.Node CoreChunkPageState.Chunk →
      Option (List NumberedPage)
  | node@(.leaf ..) => do
      let page ← encodeChunkRoot schema node
      some [page]
  | node@(.branch2 _ left separator right) => do
      let page ← encodeChunkRoot schema node
      let child ← if key < separator then encodeChunkPath schema key left
        else encodeChunkPath schema key right
      some (page :: child)
  | node@(.branch3 _ left firstSeparator middle secondSeparator right) => do
      let page ← encodeChunkRoot schema node
      let child ← if key < firstSeparator then encodeChunkPath schema key left
        else if key < secondSeparator then encodeChunkPath schema key middle
        else encodeChunkPath schema key right
      some (page :: child)

theorem encodeChunkPath_eq_mapM (schema : Core.Schema) (key : Nat)
    (node : PersistentPageTree.Node CoreChunkPageState.Chunk) :
    encodeChunkPath schema key node =
      (physicalChunkPath key node).mapM (encodePhysicalChunkPage schema) := by
  induction node with
  | leaf pageId entries =>
      simp only [encodeChunkPath, physicalChunkPath, List.mapM_cons,
        List.mapM_nil, pure, Option.pure_def]
      rw [encodeChunkRoot_eq_encodePhysicalChunkRoot]
      cases result : encodePhysicalChunkPage schema
          (physicalChunkRoot (.leaf pageId entries)) <;>
        simp [encodeChunkPath, physicalChunkPath, result]
  | branch2 pageId left separator right leftInduction rightInduction =>
      simp only [encodeChunkPath, physicalChunkPath, List.mapM_cons]
      rw [encodeChunkRoot_eq_encodePhysicalChunkRoot]
      by_cases route : key < separator
      · rw [if_pos route]
        rw [leftInduction]
        cases rootResult : encodePhysicalChunkPage schema
            (physicalChunkRoot (.branch2 pageId left separator right)) with
        | none =>
          simp [encodeChunkPath, physicalChunkPath, route, rootResult]
        | some root =>
          cases childResult : (physicalChunkPath key left).mapM
              (encodePhysicalChunkPage schema) <;>
            simp [encodeChunkPath, physicalChunkPath, route, rootResult,
              childResult]
      · rw [if_neg route]
        rw [rightInduction]
        cases rootResult : encodePhysicalChunkPage schema
            (physicalChunkRoot (.branch2 pageId left separator right)) with
        | none =>
          simp [encodeChunkPath, physicalChunkPath, route, rootResult]
        | some root =>
          cases childResult : (physicalChunkPath key right).mapM
              (encodePhysicalChunkPage schema) <;>
            simp [encodeChunkPath, physicalChunkPath, route, rootResult,
              childResult]
  | branch3 pageId left firstSeparator middle secondSeparator right
      leftInduction middleInduction rightInduction =>
      simp only [encodeChunkPath, physicalChunkPath, List.mapM_cons]
      rw [encodeChunkRoot_eq_encodePhysicalChunkRoot]
      by_cases leftRoute : key < firstSeparator
      · rw [if_pos leftRoute]
        rw [leftInduction]
        cases rootResult : encodePhysicalChunkPage schema
            (physicalChunkRoot (.branch3 pageId left firstSeparator middle
              secondSeparator right)) with
        | none =>
          simp [encodeChunkPath, physicalChunkPath, leftRoute, rootResult]
        | some root =>
          cases childResult : (physicalChunkPath key left).mapM
              (encodePhysicalChunkPage schema) <;>
            simp [encodeChunkPath, physicalChunkPath, leftRoute, rootResult,
              childResult]
      · rw [if_neg leftRoute]
        by_cases middleRoute : key < secondSeparator
        · rw [if_pos middleRoute]
          rw [middleInduction]
          cases rootResult : encodePhysicalChunkPage schema
              (physicalChunkRoot (.branch3 pageId left firstSeparator middle
                secondSeparator right)) with
          | none =>
            simp [encodeChunkPath, physicalChunkPath, leftRoute, middleRoute,
              rootResult]
          | some root =>
            cases childResult : (physicalChunkPath key middle).mapM
                (encodePhysicalChunkPage schema) <;>
              simp [encodeChunkPath, physicalChunkPath, leftRoute, middleRoute,
                rootResult, childResult]
        · rw [if_neg middleRoute]
          rw [rightInduction]
          cases rootResult : encodePhysicalChunkPage schema
              (physicalChunkRoot (.branch3 pageId left firstSeparator middle
                secondSeparator right)) with
          | none =>
            simp [encodeChunkPath, physicalChunkPath, leftRoute, middleRoute,
              rootResult]
          | some root =>
            cases childResult : (physicalChunkPath key right).mapM
                (encodePhysicalChunkPage schema) <;>
              simp [encodeChunkPath, physicalChunkPath, leftRoute, middleRoute,
                rootResult, childResult]

theorem physicalChunkPages_accounted_of_pathAgrees (key : Nat)
    {before after : PersistentPageTree.Node CoreChunkPageState.Chunk}
    (agrees : PersistentPageTree.Node.PathAgrees key before after) :
    ∀ descriptor ∈ physicalChunkPages after,
      descriptor ∈ physicalChunkPath key after ∨
        descriptor ∈ physicalChunkPages before := by
  induction agrees with
  | leaf pageId beforeEntries afterEntries =>
      intro descriptor member
      simp only [physicalChunkPages, List.mem_singleton] at member
      subst descriptor
      exact .inl (by simp [physicalChunkPath, physicalChunkRoot])
  | branch2Left pageId beforeChild afterChild separator right route child
      induction =>
      intro descriptor member
      rw [physicalChunkPages] at member
      rcases List.mem_cons.mp member with root | descendants
      · exact .inl (by
          rw [physicalChunkPath, if_pos route]
          exact List.mem_cons.mpr (.inl root))
      rcases List.mem_append.mp descendants with inChild | inRight
      · rcases induction descriptor inChild with inPath | inBefore
        · exact .inl (by
            rw [physicalChunkPath, if_pos route]
            exact List.mem_cons.mpr (.inr inPath))
        · exact .inr (by
            rw [physicalChunkPages]
            exact List.mem_cons.mpr
              (.inr (List.mem_append.mpr (.inl inBefore))))
      · exact .inr (by
          rw [physicalChunkPages]
          exact List.mem_cons.mpr
            (.inr (List.mem_append.mpr (.inr inRight))))
  | branch2Right pageId left separator beforeChild afterChild route child
      induction =>
      intro descriptor member
      rw [physicalChunkPages] at member
      rcases List.mem_cons.mp member with root | descendants
      · exact .inl (by
          rw [physicalChunkPath, if_neg route]
          exact List.mem_cons.mpr (.inl root))
      rcases List.mem_append.mp descendants with inLeft | inChild
      · exact .inr (by
          rw [physicalChunkPages]
          exact List.mem_cons.mpr
            (.inr (List.mem_append.mpr (.inl inLeft))))
      · rcases induction descriptor inChild with inPath | inBefore
        · exact .inl (by
            rw [physicalChunkPath, if_neg route]
            exact List.mem_cons.mpr (.inr inPath))
        · exact .inr (by
            rw [physicalChunkPages]
            exact List.mem_cons.mpr
              (.inr (List.mem_append.mpr (.inr inBefore))))
  | branch3Left pageId beforeChild afterChild firstSeparator middle
      secondSeparator right route child induction =>
      intro descriptor member
      rw [physicalChunkPages] at member
      rcases List.mem_cons.mp member with root | descendants
      · exact .inl (by
          rw [physicalChunkPath, if_pos route]
          exact List.mem_cons.mpr (.inl root))
      rcases List.mem_append.mp descendants with leftAndMiddle | inRight
      rcases List.mem_append.mp leftAndMiddle with inChild | inMiddle
      · rcases induction descriptor inChild with inPath | inBefore
        · exact .inl (by
            rw [physicalChunkPath, if_pos route]
            exact List.mem_cons.mpr (.inr inPath))
        · exact .inr (by
            rw [physicalChunkPages]
            exact List.mem_cons.mpr (.inr
              (List.mem_append.mpr (.inl
                (List.mem_append.mpr (.inl inBefore))))))
      · exact .inr (by
          rw [physicalChunkPages]
          exact List.mem_cons.mpr (.inr
            (List.mem_append.mpr (.inl
              (List.mem_append.mpr (.inr inMiddle))))))
      · exact .inr (by
          rw [physicalChunkPages]
          exact List.mem_cons.mpr
            (.inr (List.mem_append.mpr (.inr inRight))))
  | branch3Middle pageId left firstSeparator beforeChild afterChild
      secondSeparator right leftRoute route child induction =>
      intro descriptor member
      rw [physicalChunkPages] at member
      rcases List.mem_cons.mp member with root | descendants
      · exact .inl (by
          rw [physicalChunkPath, if_neg leftRoute, if_pos route]
          exact List.mem_cons.mpr (.inl root))
      rcases List.mem_append.mp descendants with leftAndMiddle | inRight
      rcases List.mem_append.mp leftAndMiddle with inLeft | inChild
      · exact .inr (by
          rw [physicalChunkPages]
          exact List.mem_cons.mpr (.inr
            (List.mem_append.mpr (.inl
              (List.mem_append.mpr (.inl inLeft))))))
      · rcases induction descriptor inChild with inPath | inBefore
        · exact .inl (by
            rw [physicalChunkPath, if_neg leftRoute, if_pos route]
            exact List.mem_cons.mpr (.inr inPath))
        · exact .inr (by
            rw [physicalChunkPages]
            exact List.mem_cons.mpr (.inr
              (List.mem_append.mpr (.inl
                (List.mem_append.mpr (.inr inBefore))))))
      · exact .inr (by
          rw [physicalChunkPages]
          exact List.mem_cons.mpr
            (.inr (List.mem_append.mpr (.inr inRight))))
  | branch3Right pageId left firstSeparator middle secondSeparator beforeChild
      afterChild leftRoute middleRoute child induction =>
      intro descriptor member
      rw [physicalChunkPages] at member
      rcases List.mem_cons.mp member with root | descendants
      · exact .inl (by
          rw [physicalChunkPath, if_neg leftRoute, if_neg middleRoute]
          exact List.mem_cons.mpr (.inl root))
      rcases List.mem_append.mp descendants with leftAndMiddle | inChild
      rcases List.mem_append.mp leftAndMiddle with inLeft | inMiddle
      · exact .inr (by
          rw [physicalChunkPages]
          exact List.mem_cons.mpr (.inr
            (List.mem_append.mpr (.inl
              (List.mem_append.mpr (.inl inLeft))))))
      · exact .inr (by
          rw [physicalChunkPages]
          exact List.mem_cons.mpr (.inr
            (List.mem_append.mpr (.inl
              (List.mem_append.mpr (.inr inMiddle))))))
      · rcases induction descriptor inChild with inPath | inBefore
        · exact .inl (by
            rw [physicalChunkPath, if_neg leftRoute, if_neg middleRoute]
            exact List.mem_cons.mpr (.inr inPath))
        · exact .inr (by
            rw [physicalChunkPages]
            exact List.mem_cons.mpr
              (.inr (List.mem_append.mpr (.inr inBefore))))

/-- Search-path counterpart of `exists_encodeChunkNode_of_changed`.  A local
path encoder proves every changed descriptor encodable; `PathAgrees` supplies
the unchanged subtrees from the successful pre-state encoding. -/
theorem exists_encodeChunkNode_of_pathAgrees
    (schema : Core.Schema) (key : Nat)
    {before after : PersistentPageTree.Node CoreChunkPageState.Chunk}
    (path beforePages : List NumberedPage)
    (agrees : PersistentPageTree.Node.PathAgrees key before after)
    (pathEncoded : encodeChunkPath schema key after = some path)
    (beforeEncoded : encodeChunkNode schema before = some beforePages) :
    ∃ afterPages, encodeChunkNode schema after = some afterPages := by
  rw [encodeChunkPath_eq_mapM] at pathEncoded
  rw [encodeChunkNode_eq_mapM] at beforeEncoded ⊢
  apply exists_mapM_of_forall_some
  intro descriptor descriptorMember
  rcases physicalChunkPages_accounted_of_pathAgrees key agrees descriptor
      descriptorMember with inPath | inBefore
  · rcases mapM_encodePhysicalChunkPage_input schema pathEncoded descriptor
        inPath with ⟨page, _, encoded⟩
    exact ⟨page, encoded⟩
  · rcases mapM_encodePhysicalChunkPage_input schema beforeEncoded descriptor
        inBefore with ⟨page, _, encoded⟩
    exact ⟨page, encoded⟩

/-- If two persistent trees differ only along one search path, encoding that
post-state path accounts for every new byte image.  Pages off the path are
present byte-for-byte in the complete pre-state encoding. -/
theorem encodeChunkPath_accounts_of_pathAgrees (schema : Core.Schema)
    (key : Nat)
    {before after : PersistentPageTree.Node CoreChunkPageState.Chunk}
    (path beforePages afterPages : List NumberedPage)
    (agrees : PersistentPageTree.Node.PathAgrees key before after)
    (pathEncoded : encodeChunkPath schema key after = some path)
    (beforeEncoded : encodeChunkNode schema before = some beforePages)
    (afterEncoded : encodeChunkNode schema after = some afterPages) :
    ∀ page ∈ afterPages, page ∈ path ∨ page ∈ beforePages := by
  rw [encodeChunkPath_eq_mapM] at pathEncoded
  rw [encodeChunkNode_eq_mapM] at beforeEncoded afterEncoded
  intro page pageMember
  rcases mapM_encodePhysicalChunkPage_output schema afterEncoded page
      pageMember with ⟨descriptor, descriptorMember, descriptorEncoded⟩
  rcases physicalChunkPages_accounted_of_pathAgrees key agrees descriptor
      descriptorMember with inPath | inBefore
  · left
    rcases mapM_encodePhysicalChunkPage_input schema pathEncoded descriptor
        inPath with ⟨selected, selectedMember, selectedEncoded⟩
    have equal : selected = page := Option.some.inj
      (selectedEncoded.symm.trans descriptorEncoded)
    simpa [equal] using selectedMember
  · right
    rcases mapM_encodePhysicalChunkPage_input schema beforeEncoded descriptor
        inBefore with ⟨old, oldMember, oldEncoded⟩
    have equal : old = page := Option.some.inj
      (oldEncoded.symm.trans descriptorEncoded)
    simpa [equal] using oldMember

/-- A localized root-to-leaf encoding contains only pages from the complete
encoding of the same persistent tree.  It may omit unchanged siblings, but it
cannot invent a page identity or byte image. -/
theorem encodeChunkPath_subset_encodeChunkNode (schema : Core.Schema)
    (key : Nat) :
    ∀ (node : PersistentPageTree.Node CoreChunkPageState.Chunk)
      (path pages : List NumberedPage),
      encodeChunkPath schema key node = some path →
      encodeChunkNode schema node = some pages →
      ∀ page ∈ path, page ∈ pages
  | .leaf pageId entries, path, pages, pathEncoded, pagesEncoded => by
      cases leafResult : encodeChunkLeaf schema entries with
      | none =>
        simp [encodeChunkPath, encodeChunkRoot, leafResult] at pathEncoded
      | some leaf =>
        simp [encodeChunkPath, encodeChunkRoot, encodeChunkNode, leafResult] at pathEncoded pagesEncoded
        subst path
        subst pages
        simp
  | .branch2 pageId left separator right, path, pages, pathEncoded,
      pagesEncoded => by
      cases keyResult : maximumChunkRowid? left with
      | none =>
        simp [encodeChunkPath, encodeChunkRoot, keyResult] at pathEncoded
      | some leftKey =>
        cases pageResult : RecursivePageBTree.interiorPage?
            [(left.rootId, leftKey)] right.rootId with
        | none =>
          simp [encodeChunkPath, encodeChunkRoot, keyResult, pageResult] at pathEncoded
        | some rootPage =>
          cases leftResult : encodeChunkNode schema left with
          | none =>
            simp [encodeChunkNode, keyResult, pageResult, leftResult] at pagesEncoded
          | some leftPages =>
            cases rightResult : encodeChunkNode schema right with
            | none =>
              simp [encodeChunkNode, keyResult, pageResult, leftResult,
                rightResult] at pagesEncoded
            | some rightPages =>
              simp [encodeChunkNode, keyResult, pageResult, leftResult,
                rightResult] at pagesEncoded
              subst pages
              by_cases route : key < separator
              · cases childResult : encodeChunkPath schema key left with
                | none =>
                  simp [encodeChunkPath, encodeChunkRoot, keyResult, pageResult,
                    route, childResult] at pathEncoded
                | some child =>
                  simp [encodeChunkPath, encodeChunkRoot, keyResult, pageResult,
                    route, childResult] at pathEncoded
                  subst path
                  intro page member
                  simp only [List.mem_cons] at member
                  rcases member with rfl | childMember
                  · simp
                  · simp only [List.mem_cons, List.mem_append]
                    exact .inr (.inl
                      (encodeChunkPath_subset_encodeChunkNode schema key left
                        child leftPages childResult leftResult page childMember))
              · cases childResult : encodeChunkPath schema key right with
                | none =>
                  simp [encodeChunkPath, encodeChunkRoot, keyResult, pageResult,
                    route, childResult] at pathEncoded
                | some child =>
                  simp [encodeChunkPath, encodeChunkRoot, keyResult, pageResult,
                    route, childResult] at pathEncoded
                  subst path
                  intro page member
                  simp only [List.mem_cons] at member
                  rcases member with rfl | childMember
                  · simp
                  · simp only [List.mem_cons, List.mem_append]
                    exact .inr (.inr
                      (encodeChunkPath_subset_encodeChunkNode schema key right
                        child rightPages childResult rightResult page childMember))
  | .branch3 pageId left firstSeparator middle secondSeparator right,
      path, pages, pathEncoded, pagesEncoded => by
      cases leftKeyResult : maximumChunkRowid? left with
      | none =>
        simp [encodeChunkPath, encodeChunkRoot, leftKeyResult] at pathEncoded
      | some leftKey =>
        cases middleKeyResult : maximumChunkRowid? middle with
        | none =>
          simp [encodeChunkPath, encodeChunkRoot, leftKeyResult,
            middleKeyResult] at pathEncoded
        | some middleKey =>
          cases pageResult : RecursivePageBTree.interiorPage?
              [(left.rootId, leftKey), (middle.rootId, middleKey)]
              right.rootId with
          | none =>
            simp [encodeChunkPath, encodeChunkRoot, leftKeyResult,
              middleKeyResult, pageResult] at pathEncoded
          | some rootPage =>
            cases leftResult : encodeChunkNode schema left with
            | none =>
              simp [encodeChunkNode, leftKeyResult, middleKeyResult, pageResult,
                leftResult] at pagesEncoded
            | some leftPages =>
              cases middleResult : encodeChunkNode schema middle with
              | none =>
                simp [encodeChunkNode, leftKeyResult, middleKeyResult,
                  pageResult, leftResult, middleResult] at pagesEncoded
              | some middlePages =>
                cases rightResult : encodeChunkNode schema right with
                | none =>
                  simp [encodeChunkNode, leftKeyResult, middleKeyResult,
                    pageResult, leftResult, middleResult, rightResult] at pagesEncoded
                | some rightPages =>
                  simp [encodeChunkNode, leftKeyResult, middleKeyResult,
                    pageResult, leftResult, middleResult, rightResult] at pagesEncoded
                  subst pages
                  by_cases leftRoute : key < firstSeparator
                  · cases childResult : encodeChunkPath schema key left with
                    | none =>
                      simp [encodeChunkPath, encodeChunkRoot, leftKeyResult,
                        middleKeyResult, pageResult, leftRoute, childResult] at pathEncoded
                    | some child =>
                      simp [encodeChunkPath, encodeChunkRoot, leftKeyResult,
                        middleKeyResult, pageResult, leftRoute, childResult] at pathEncoded
                      subst path
                      intro page member
                      simp only [List.mem_cons] at member
                      rcases member with rfl | childMember
                      · simp
                      · simp only [List.mem_cons, List.mem_append]
                        exact .inr (.inl
                          (encodeChunkPath_subset_encodeChunkNode schema key left
                            child leftPages childResult leftResult page childMember))
                  · by_cases middleRoute : key < secondSeparator
                    · cases childResult : encodeChunkPath schema key middle with
                      | none =>
                        simp [encodeChunkPath, encodeChunkRoot, leftKeyResult,
                          middleKeyResult, pageResult, leftRoute, middleRoute,
                          childResult] at pathEncoded
                      | some child =>
                        simp [encodeChunkPath, encodeChunkRoot, leftKeyResult,
                          middleKeyResult, pageResult, leftRoute, middleRoute,
                          childResult] at pathEncoded
                        subst path
                        intro page member
                        simp only [List.mem_cons] at member
                        rcases member with rfl | childMember
                        · simp
                        · simp only [List.mem_cons, List.mem_append]
                          exact .inr (.inr (.inl
                            (encodeChunkPath_subset_encodeChunkNode schema key
                              middle child middlePages childResult middleResult
                              page childMember)))
                    · cases childResult : encodeChunkPath schema key right with
                      | none =>
                        simp [encodeChunkPath, encodeChunkRoot, leftKeyResult,
                          middleKeyResult, pageResult, leftRoute, middleRoute,
                          childResult] at pathEncoded
                      | some child =>
                        simp [encodeChunkPath, encodeChunkRoot, leftKeyResult,
                          middleKeyResult, pageResult, leftRoute, middleRoute,
                          childResult] at pathEncoded
                        subst path
                        intro page member
                        simp only [List.mem_cons] at member
                        rcases member with rfl | childMember
                        · simp
                        · simp only [List.mem_cons, List.mem_append]
                          exact .inr (.inr (.inr
                            (encodeChunkPath_subset_encodeChunkNode schema key
                              right child rightPages childResult rightResult page
                              childMember)))

def encodeChunkTable (state : CoreChunkPageState.TableState) :
    Option (List NumberedPage) :=
  encodeChunkNode state.table.schema state.tree.root

def encodeChunkTables : List CoreChunkPageState.TableState →
    Option (List NumberedPage)
  | [] => some []
  | table :: tables => do
      let head ← encodeChunkTable table
      let tail ← encodeChunkTables tables
      some (head ++ tail)

/-- A store-owned table encoding. Tree page identities come exclusively from
the persistent node; overflow pages are allocated after the entire identified
tree interval and therefore cannot perturb its topology. -/
structure OverflowEncoding where
  treePages : List NumberedPage
  overflowPages : List CoreFile.Page
  nextPage : Nat

/-- Every row stored below a persistent table node has a record payload which
fits in the local part of a SQLite table-leaf cell.  The recursive shape makes
the invariant compositional across page-local tree edits. -/
def NodeRowsInline (schema : Core.Schema) :
    PersistentPageTree.Node CoreChunkPageState.Chunk → Prop
  | .leaf _ entries => ∀ entry ∈ entries, ∀ row ∈ entry.2,
      CoreOverflow.RowInline schema row
  | .branch2 _ left _ right =>
      NodeRowsInline schema left ∧ NodeRowsInline schema right
  | .branch3 _ left _ middle _ right =>
      NodeRowsInline schema left ∧ NodeRowsInline schema middle ∧
        NodeRowsInline schema right

/-- A pointwise property of the logical row abstraction establishes the
recursive inline invariant, independent of the tree's current topology. -/
theorem nodeRowsInline_of_mem_rows (schema : Core.Schema) :
    ∀ (node : PersistentPageTree.Node CoreChunkPageState.Chunk),
      (∀ row ∈ CoreChunkPageState.Node.rows node,
        CoreOverflow.RowInline schema row) →
      NodeRowsInline schema node
  | .leaf pageId entries, inline => by
      simp only [NodeRowsInline]
      intro entry entryMember row rowMember
      apply inline row
      unfold CoreChunkPageState.Node.rows
      simp only [PersistentPageTree.Node.erase,
        RecursiveBPlusTree.Node.toList]
      exact List.mem_flatMap.mpr ⟨entry, entryMember, rowMember⟩
  | .branch2 pageId left separator right, inline => by
      simp only [NodeRowsInline]
      constructor
      · apply nodeRowsInline_of_mem_rows schema left
        intro row member
        apply inline row
        unfold CoreChunkPageState.Node.rows at member ⊢
        simp only [PersistentPageTree.Node.erase,
          RecursiveBPlusTree.Node.toList, List.flatMap_append,
          List.mem_append]
        exact Or.inl member
      · apply nodeRowsInline_of_mem_rows schema right
        intro row member
        apply inline row
        unfold CoreChunkPageState.Node.rows at member ⊢
        simp only [PersistentPageTree.Node.erase,
          RecursiveBPlusTree.Node.toList, List.flatMap_append,
          List.mem_append]
        exact Or.inr member
  | .branch3 pageId left firstSeparator middle secondSeparator right,
      inline => by
      simp only [NodeRowsInline]
      constructor
      · apply nodeRowsInline_of_mem_rows schema left
        intro row member
        apply inline row
        unfold CoreChunkPageState.Node.rows at member ⊢
        simp only [PersistentPageTree.Node.erase,
          RecursiveBPlusTree.Node.toList, List.flatMap_append,
          List.mem_append]
        exact Or.inl (Or.inl member)
      · constructor
        · apply nodeRowsInline_of_mem_rows schema middle
          intro row member
          apply inline row
          unfold CoreChunkPageState.Node.rows at member ⊢
          simp only [PersistentPageTree.Node.erase,
            RecursiveBPlusTree.Node.toList, List.flatMap_append,
            List.mem_append]
          exact Or.inl (Or.inr member)
        · apply nodeRowsInline_of_mem_rows schema right
          intro row member
          apply inline row
          unfold CoreChunkPageState.Node.rows at member ⊢
          simp only [PersistentPageTree.Node.erase,
            RecursiveBPlusTree.Node.toList, List.flatMap_append,
            List.mem_append]
          exact Or.inr member

/-- A table state's logical representation equation lifts a row-wise payload
bound to the exact persistent tree used by the localized writer. -/
theorem tableStateRowsInline_of_rows
    (state : CoreChunkPageState.TableState)
    (inline : ∀ row ∈ state.table.rows,
      CoreOverflow.RowInline state.table.schema row) :
    NodeRowsInline state.table.schema state.tree.root := by
  apply nodeRowsInline_of_mem_rows state.table.schema state.tree.root
  intro row member
  apply inline row
  rw [← state.represents]
  exact member

/-- Exact logical table condition used by the paper's YCSB evaluation. -/
def YCSBTableState (state : CoreChunkPageState.TableState) : Prop :=
  state.table.schema = CoreOverflow.ycsbSchema ∧
    ∀ row ∈ state.table.rows, CoreOverflow.YCSBRow row

theorem YCSBTableState.rowsInline
    {state : CoreChunkPageState.TableState}
    (shape : YCSBTableState state) :
    NodeRowsInline state.table.schema state.tree.root := by
  apply tableStateRowsInline_of_rows state
  intro row member
  rw [shape.1]
  exact (shape.2 row member).inline

private theorem tableCellPlans_payload_le_of_rowsInline
    (schema : Core.Schema) : ∀ (rows : List Core.Row)
      (plans : List CoreOverflow.CellPlan),
      rows.mapM (CoreOverflow.tableCellPlan? schema) = some plans →
      (∀ row ∈ rows, CoreOverflow.RowInline schema row) →
      ∀ plan ∈ plans,
        plan.payload.length ≤ CoreOverflow.maxLocal plan.kind
  | [], plans, planned, _ => by
      change some [] = some plans at planned
      have empty : plans = [] := (Option.some.inj planned).symm
      subst plans
      simp
  | row :: rows, plans, planned, inline => by
      simp only [List.mapM_cons] at planned
      cases planResult : CoreOverflow.tableCellPlan? schema row with
      | none => simp [planResult] at planned
      | some plan =>
          simp only [planResult, Option.bind_eq_bind, Option.bind] at planned
          cases tailResult : rows.mapM (CoreOverflow.tableCellPlan? schema) with
          | none => simp [tailResult] at planned
          | some tail =>
              simp only [tailResult, Option.some.injEq] at planned
              have plansEqual : plans = plan :: tail :=
                (Option.some.inj planned).symm
              subst plans
              intro candidate member
              simp only [List.mem_cons] at member
              rcases member with rfl | tailMember
              · have rowInline := inline row (by simp)
                have payload := CoreOverflow.tableCellPlan_payload_le_of_inline
                  rowInline planResult
                rw [CoreOverflow.tableCellPlan_kind planResult]
                exact payload
              · apply tableCellPlans_payload_le_of_rowsInline schema rows tail
                  tailResult
                · intro tailRow tailRowMember
                  exact inline tailRow (by simp [tailRowMember])
                · exact tailMember

private theorem tableCellPlan_cellBytes_none_encodeCell
    {schema : Core.Schema} {row : Core.Row}
    {plan : CoreOverflow.CellPlan} {cell : List UInt8}
    (planned : CoreOverflow.tableCellPlan? schema row = some plan)
    (built : plan.cellBytes? none = some cell) :
    CoreRecord.encodeCell? schema row = some cell := by
  unfold CoreOverflow.tableCellPlan? at planned
  unfold CoreRecord.encodeCell?
  cases recordResult : CoreRecord.rowRecord? schema row with
  | none => simp [recordResult] at planned
  | some record =>
    simp only [recordResult, Option.bind_eq_bind, Option.bind] at planned ⊢
    split at planned
    next bounded =>
      simp only [Option.some.injEq] at planned
      subst plan
      unfold CoreOverflow.CellPlan.cellBytes? at built
      split at built
      next =>
        simp only [Option.some.injEq] at built
        subst cell
        rw [dif_pos bounded]
      next => simp at built
    next => contradiction

theorem tableCellPlan_cellBytes_none_of_inline_encodeCell
    {schema : Core.Schema} {row : Core.Row} {cell : List UInt8}
    (inline : CoreOverflow.RowInline schema row)
    (encoded : CoreRecord.encodeCell? schema row = some cell) :
    ∃ plan : CoreOverflow.CellPlan,
      CoreOverflow.tableCellPlan? schema row = some plan ∧
      plan.cellBytes? none = some cell := by
  unfold CoreRecord.encodeCell? at encoded
  cases recordResult : CoreRecord.rowRecord? schema row with
  | none => simp [recordResult] at encoded
  | some record =>
      simp only [recordResult, Option.bind_eq_bind, Option.bind] at encoded
      split at encoded
      next bounded =>
        injection encoded with cellEqual
        subst cell
        let plan : CoreOverflow.CellPlan := {
          kind := .table
          cellPrefix := FileFormat.encodeVarint
              ⟨record.encode.length, by simpa using bounded⟩ ++
            FileFormat.encodeVarint (FileFormat.signedInteger64Bits row.rowid)
          payload := record.encode }
        refine ⟨plan, ?_, ?_⟩
        · simp [CoreOverflow.tableCellPlan?, recordResult, bounded, plan]
        · simp [CoreOverflow.CellPlan.cellBytes?,
            inline record recordResult, plan, List.append_assoc]
      next => contradiction

theorem tableCellPlans_of_inline_encodeCells
    (schema : Core.Schema) : ∀ (rows : List Core.Row)
      (cells : List (List UInt8)),
      rows.mapM (CoreRecord.encodeCell? schema) = some cells →
      (∀ row ∈ rows, CoreOverflow.RowInline schema row) →
      ∃ plans : List CoreOverflow.CellPlan,
        rows.mapM (CoreOverflow.tableCellPlan? schema) = some plans ∧
        plans.mapM (fun plan => plan.cellBytes? none) = some cells
  | [], cells, encoded, _ => by
      change some [] = some cells at encoded
      have empty : cells = [] := (Option.some.inj encoded).symm
      subst cells
      exact ⟨[], rfl, rfl⟩
  | row :: rows, cells, encoded, inline => by
      simp only [List.mapM_cons] at encoded
      cases cellResult : CoreRecord.encodeCell? schema row with
      | none => simp [cellResult] at encoded
      | some cell =>
          simp only [cellResult, Option.bind_eq_bind, Option.bind] at encoded
          cases tailResult : rows.mapM (CoreRecord.encodeCell? schema) with
          | none => simp [tailResult] at encoded
          | some tail =>
              simp only [tailResult, Option.some.injEq] at encoded
              have cellsEqual : cells = cell :: tail :=
                (Option.some.inj encoded).symm
              subst cells
              rcases tableCellPlan_cellBytes_none_of_inline_encodeCell
                  (inline row (by simp)) cellResult with
                ⟨plan, planResult, planCell⟩
              rcases tableCellPlans_of_inline_encodeCells schema rows tail
                  tailResult (by
                    intro tailRow member
                    exact inline tailRow (by simp [member])) with
                ⟨plans, plansResult, planCells⟩
              refine ⟨plan :: plans, ?_, ?_⟩
              · simp [planResult, plansResult]
              · simp [planCell, planCells]

private theorem tableCellPlans_noOverflow_encodeCells
    (schema : Core.Schema) : ∀ (rows : List Core.Row)
      (plans : List CoreOverflow.CellPlan) (cells : List (List UInt8)),
      rows.mapM (CoreOverflow.tableCellPlan? schema) = some plans →
      plans.mapM (fun plan => plan.cellBytes? none) = some cells →
      rows.mapM (CoreRecord.encodeCell? schema) = some cells
  | [], plans, cells, planned, built => by
      change some [] = some plans at planned
      have plansEmpty : plans = [] := (Option.some.inj planned).symm
      subst plans
      change some [] = some cells at built
      have cellsEmpty : cells = [] := (Option.some.inj built).symm
      subst cells
      rfl
  | row :: rows, plans, cells, planned, built => by
      simp only [List.mapM_cons] at planned built ⊢
      cases planResult : CoreOverflow.tableCellPlan? schema row with
      | none => simp [planResult] at planned
      | some plan =>
        simp only [planResult, Option.bind_eq_bind, Option.bind] at planned
        cases tailPlansResult :
            rows.mapM (CoreOverflow.tableCellPlan? schema) with
        | none => simp [tailPlansResult] at planned
        | some tailPlans =>
          simp only [tailPlansResult] at planned
          change some (plan :: tailPlans) = some plans at planned
          have plansEqual : plans = plan :: tailPlans :=
            (Option.some.inj planned).symm
          subst plans
          rw [List.mapM_cons] at built
          cases cellResult : plan.cellBytes? none with
          | none => simp [cellResult] at built
          | some cell =>
            rw [cellResult] at built
            cases tailCellsResult :
                tailPlans.mapM (fun candidate => candidate.cellBytes? none) with
            | none =>
              rw [tailCellsResult] at built
              change none = some cells at built
              contradiction
            | some tailCells =>
              rw [tailCellsResult] at built
              change some (cell :: tailCells) = some cells at built
              have cellsEqual : cells = cell :: tailCells :=
                (Option.some.inj built).symm
              subst cells
              have headEncoded := tableCellPlan_cellBytes_none_encodeCell
                planResult cellResult
              have tailEncoded := tableCellPlans_noOverflow_encodeCells schema
                rows tailPlans tailCells tailPlansResult tailCellsResult
              rw [headEncoded, tailEncoded]
              rfl

def encodeChunkNodeWithOverflow (schema : Core.Schema) :
    PersistentPageTree.Node CoreChunkPageState.Chunk → Nat →
      Option OverflowEncoding
