          subst pages
          unfold CoreDecode.decodeSubtreeRowsFrom
          change (source.readPage pageId >>= _) = _
          rw [contains ⟨pageId, page⟩ (by simp)]
          simp only [Option.bind_eq_bind, Option.bind]
          rw [CorePageCodec.interiorChildren_encodeChunkLeaf schema entries page
            pageResult]
          rw [decodeRowsFrom_encodeChunkLeaf schema entries page (by
            intro entry member row rowMember
            exact valid entry (by simpa [WidePageTree.Node.toList] using member)
              row rowMember) (by
            intro entry member row rowMember
            exact inline entry (by simpa [WidePageTree.Node.toList] using member)
              row rowMember) pageResult source]
          simp [CoreWidePageState.Node.rows, WidePageTree.Node.toList]
        | branch pageId children =>
          simp only [CoreWidePageCodec.encodeChunkNode] at encoded
          rcases Option.bind_eq_some_iff.mp encoded with ⟨parts, partsResult, encoded⟩
          rcases parts with ⟨cells, rightmost⟩
          rcases Option.bind_eq_some_iff.mp encoded with ⟨rootPage, rootResult, encoded⟩
          rcases Option.bind_eq_some_iff.mp encoded with
            ⟨childPages, childrenResult, encoded⟩
          simp only [Option.some.injEq] at encoded
          subst pages
          have rootRead : source.readPage pageId = some rootPage.bytes :=
            contains ⟨pageId, rootPage⟩ (by simp)
          have childrenContain : CorePageCodec.PageSourceContains source
              childPages.flatten := by
            intro page member
            exact contains page (by simp [member])
          have childValid : ∀ child ∈ children, RowsValid schema child := by
            intro child childMember entry entryMember row rowMember
            exact valid entry (by
              simp only [WidePageTree.Node.toList, List.mem_flatMap]
              exact ⟨child, childMember, entryMember⟩) row rowMember
          have childInline : ∀ child ∈ children,
              RowsInline schema child := by
            intro child childMember entry entryMember row rowMember
            exact inline entry (by
              simp only [WidePageTree.Node.toList, List.mem_flatMap]
              exact ⟨child, childMember, entryMember⟩) row rowMember
          have childrenDecoded := decodeChildrenFold schema source fuel decodeFuel
            (fun child pages childEncoded childContains childValid childInline =>
              induction child pages decodeFuel childEncoded
                (Nat.le_of_succ_le_succ fuelBound) childContains childValid
                childInline)
            children childPages [] childrenResult childrenContain
              childValid childInline
          unfold CoreDecode.decodeSubtreeRowsFrom
          change (source.readPage pageId >>= _) = _
          rw [rootRead]
          simp only [Option.bind_eq_bind, Option.bind]
          rw [interiorChildren_interiorPage cells rightmost.rootId rootResult]
          rw [interiorCells?_pageNumbers partsResult]
          have rowsEqual := flatMap_node_rows children
          have branchRows :
              CoreWidePageState.Node.rows
                  (WidePageTree.Node.branch pageId children) =
                children.flatMap CoreWidePageState.Node.rows := by
            unfold CoreWidePageState.Node.rows
            simp only [WidePageTree.Node.toList]
            exact rowsEqual.symm
          change (children.map WidePageTree.Node.rootId).foldlM
              (fun rows child => do
                let decoded ← CoreDecode.decodeSubtreeRowsFrom schema source decodeFuel child
                some (rows ++ decoded)) [] =
              some (CoreWidePageState.Node.rows
                (WidePageTree.Node.branch pageId children))
          rw [branchRows]
          simpa using childrenDecoded

/-- One encoded high-fanout table decodes to the same logical table, with
indexes intentionally restored by the separate index pass. -/
theorem decodeTableFrom_encodeTable (source : CoreDecode.PageSource)
    (state : CoreWidePageState.TableState)
    (pages : List CorePageCodec.NumberedPage)
    (encoded : CoreWidePageCodec.encodeTable state = some pages)
    (contains : CorePageCodec.PageSourceContains source pages)
    (heightBound : state.tree.root.height < source.pageCount + 1)
    (inline : ∀ row ∈ state.table.rows,
      CoreOverflow.RowInline state.table.schema row) :
    CoreDecode.decodeTableFrom source
      (CoreDecode.CatalogEntry.ofEncoded
        (CoreWidePageCodec.tableCatalogEntry state)) =
      some state.table.withoutIndexes := by
  have rowsValid : RowsValid state.table.schema state.tree.root := by
    intro entry entryMember row rowMember
    have member : row ∈ CoreWidePageState.Node.rows state.tree.root := by
      unfold CoreWidePageState.Node.rows
      exact List.mem_flatMap.mpr ⟨entry, entryMember, rowMember⟩
    change row ∈ CoreWidePageState.Store.rows state.tree at member
    rw [state.represents] at member
    exact state.table.rowsWellFormed.1 row member
  have rowsInline : RowsInline state.table.schema state.tree.root := by
    intro entry entryMember row rowMember
    apply inline row
    rw [← state.represents]
    unfold CoreWidePageState.Store.rows CoreWidePageState.Node.rows
    exact List.mem_flatMap.mpr ⟨entry, entryMember, rowMember⟩
  have decodedRows := decodeSubtreeRowsFrom_encodeChunkNode
    state.table.schema source (state.tree.root.height + 1) state.tree.root
      pages (source.pageCount + 1) encoded (by omega) contains rowsValid
      rowsInline
  unfold CoreDecode.decodeTableFrom CoreWidePageCodec.tableCatalogEntry
    CoreDecode.CatalogEntry.ofEncoded
  simp only [Bool.false_eq_true, if_false, dif_pos True.intro,
    Option.bind_eq_bind, Option.bind]
  unfold CoreFile.tableSQL CoreWidePageState.TableState.rootPage
  rw [CoreDecode.parseTableSchema_catalogSQL state.table]
  simp only [Option.bind_eq_bind, Option.bind, dif_pos True.intro]
  rw [decodedRows]
  simp only [Option.bind_eq_bind, Option.bind]
  rw [Core.Table.rebuildFromCatalog_catalogSQL]
  change (Core.Table.rebuild state.table.schema []
    (CoreWidePageState.Store.rows state.tree) state.table.catalogSource).toOption = _
  rw [state.represents, Core.Table.rebuild_withoutIndexes]
  rfl

private theorem encodeChunkNode_height_lt_length_succ (schema : Core.Schema) :
    ∀ (fuel : Nat) (node : WidePageTree.Node CoreWidePageState.Chunk)
      (pages : List CorePageCodec.NumberedPage),
      CoreWidePageCodec.encodeChunkNode fuel schema node = some pages →
      node.height < pages.length + 1 := by
  intro fuel
  induction fuel with
  | zero =>
      intro node pages encoded
      simp [CoreWidePageCodec.encodeChunkNode] at encoded
  | succ fuel induction =>
      intro node pages encoded
      cases node with
      | leaf pageId entries =>
          simp only [CoreWidePageCodec.encodeChunkNode] at encoded
          rcases Option.bind_eq_some_iff.mp encoded with ⟨page, _, encoded⟩
          simp only [Option.some.injEq] at encoded
          subst pages
          simp [WidePageTree.Node.height]
      | branch pageId children =>
          simp only [CoreWidePageCodec.encodeChunkNode] at encoded
          rcases Option.bind_eq_some_iff.mp encoded with ⟨parts, partsResult, encoded⟩
          rcases parts with ⟨cells, rightmost⟩
          rcases Option.bind_eq_some_iff.mp encoded with ⟨page, _, encoded⟩
          rcases Option.bind_eq_some_iff.mp encoded with
            ⟨childPages, childrenResult, encoded⟩
          simp only [Option.some.injEq] at encoded
          subst pages
          cases children with
          | nil =>
              unfold CoreWidePageCodec.interiorCells? at partsResult
              simp [WidePageTree.splitLast?] at partsResult
          | cons child children =>
              simp only [List.mapM_cons] at childrenResult
              rcases Option.bind_eq_some_iff.mp childrenResult with
                ⟨headPages, headResult, childrenResult⟩
              rcases Option.bind_eq_some_iff.mp childrenResult with
                ⟨tailPages, tailResult, childrenResult⟩
              simp only [pure, Option.pure_def, Option.some.injEq] at childrenResult
              subst childPages
              have childHeight := induction child headPages headResult
              have headLength : headPages.length ≤
                  (headPages :: tailPages).flatten.length := by simp
              simp only [WidePageTree.Node.height, List.length_cons]
              omega

private theorem decodeTablesFrom_encodeTables
    (source : CoreDecode.PageSource) :
    ∀ (tables : List CoreWidePageState.TableState)
      (pages : List CorePageCodec.NumberedPage),
      CoreWidePageCodec.encodeTables tables = some pages →
      CorePageCodec.PageSourceContains source pages →
      pages.length ≤ source.pageCount →
      (∀ table ∈ tables, ∀ row ∈ table.table.rows,
        CoreOverflow.RowInline table.table.schema row) →
      (tables.map (fun table => CoreDecode.CatalogEntry.ofEncoded
        (CoreWidePageCodec.tableCatalogEntry table))).mapM
          (CoreDecode.decodeTableFrom source) =
        some (tables.map (fun table => table.table.withoutIndexes))
  | [], pages, encoded, _, _, _ => by
      simp only [CoreWidePageCodec.encodeTables, List.mapM_nil, pure,
        Option.pure_def, Option.bind_eq_bind, Option.bind,
        Option.some.injEq] at encoded
      subst pages
      rfl
  | table :: tables, pages, encoded, contains, pageBound, inline => by
      unfold CoreWidePageCodec.encodeTables at encoded
      cases headResult : CoreWidePageCodec.encodeTable table with
      | none => simp [headResult] at encoded
      | some headPages =>
          cases tailResult : tables.mapM CoreWidePageCodec.encodeTable with
          | none => simp [headResult, tailResult] at encoded
          | some tailGroups =>
              simp only [List.mapM_cons, headResult, tailResult,
                Option.bind_eq_bind, Option.bind, pure, Option.pure_def,
                Option.some.injEq] at encoded
              subst pages
              have headContains :
                  CorePageCodec.PageSourceContains source headPages := by
                intro page member
                exact contains page (by simp [member])
              have tailContains : CorePageCodec.PageSourceContains source
                  tailGroups.flatten := by
                intro page member
                exact contains page (by simp [member])
              have headDecoded := decodeTableFrom_encodeTable source table
                headPages headResult headContains (by
                  have height := encodeChunkNode_height_lt_length_succ
                    table.table.schema (table.tree.root.height + 1)
                      table.tree.root headPages headResult
                  have lengthBound : headPages.length ≤ source.pageCount := by
                    have : headPages.length ≤
                        (headPages :: tailGroups).flatten.length := by simp
                    omega
                  omega)
                (fun row member => inline table (by simp) row member)
              have tailEncoded : CoreWidePageCodec.encodeTables tables =
                  some tailGroups.flatten := by
                unfold CoreWidePageCodec.encodeTables
                rw [tailResult]
                rfl
              have tailDecoded := decodeTablesFrom_encodeTables source tables
                tailGroups.flatten tailEncoded tailContains
                (by
                  have : tailGroups.flatten.length ≤
                      (headPages :: tailGroups).flatten.length := by simp
                  omega)
                (fun candidate member => inline candidate (by simp [member]))
              simp only [List.map_cons, List.mapM_cons, headDecoded, tailDecoded,
                Option.bind_eq_bind, Option.bind]
              rfl

/-- The complete inline high-fanout image has the logical meaning carried by
its proof-owned state.  Tables are decoded by arbitrary-fanout traversal;
secondary indexes reuse the established promoted-key inverse. -/
theorem pageSourceRepresents_encodeBulkInlineWithState
    (utf8 : CoreDecode.UTF8Roundtrips) (database : Core.Database)
    (image : CoreFile.Image) (wideState : CoreWidePageState.State)
    (encoded : CoreWidePageCodec.encodeBulkInlineWithState database =
      some (image, wideState)) :
    CoreDecode.PageSourceRepresents
      (.ofList (image.pages.map CoreFile.Page.bytes)) database := by
  unfold CoreWidePageCodec.encodeBulkInlineWithState at encoded
  rcases Option.bind_eq_some_iff.mp encoded with ⟨state, stateResult, encoded⟩
  split at encoded
  next inlineResult =>
    rcases Option.bind_eq_some_iff.mp encoded with
      ⟨numbered, numberedResult, encoded⟩
    let ordered := CorePageCodec.orderNumberedPages
      (CoreWidePageCodec.includePendingBytePlaceholder state.nextPage numbered)
    dsimp only at encoded
    split at encoded
    next numbers =>
      rcases Option.bind_eq_some_iff.mp encoded with
        ⟨indexEncodings, indexResult, encoded⟩
      split at encoded
      next countBound =>
        let tableEntries := state.tables.map CoreWidePageCodec.tableCatalogEntry
        let indexEntries := CoreWideIndex.indexEntriesOf indexEncodings
        let entries := tableEntries ++ indexEntries
        let indexPages := CoreWideIndex.indexPagesOf indexEncodings
        let remaining := ordered.map CorePageCodec.NumberedPage.page ++ indexPages
        let count : FileFormat.U32Value := ⟨1 + remaining.length, by
          change 1 + remaining.length < 2 ^ 32
          have stronger : 1 + remaining.length + 1 < 2 ^ 32 := by
            simpa [remaining, ordered, indexPages] using countBound
          omega⟩
        change (do
          let schema ← CoreFile.schemaPageForEntries? entries count
          some (⟨database, schema :: remaining⟩, state)) =
            some (image, wideState) at encoded
        cases schemaResult : CoreFile.schemaPageForEntries? entries count with
        | none => simp [schemaResult] at encoded
        | some schemaPage =>
          rw [schemaResult] at encoded
          simp only [Option.bind_eq_bind, Option.bind, Option.some.injEq,
            Prod.mk.injEq] at encoded
          rcases encoded with ⟨imageEqual, stateEqual⟩
          subst image
          subst wideState
          let source : CoreDecode.PageSource := .ofList
            ((schemaPage :: remaining).map CoreFile.Page.bytes)
          have stateNextLower : 2 ≤ state.nextPage :=
            CoreWidePageState.State.build?_nextPage_ge stateResult
          have orderedCount : ordered.length = state.nextPage - 2 := by
            have lengths := congrArg List.length numbers
            simpa using lengths
          have startEqual : 2 + ordered.length = state.nextPage := by
            rw [orderedCount]
            omega
          have orderedNumbers : ordered.map
              CorePageCodec.NumberedPage.pageNumber =
                List.range' 2 ordered.length := by
            simpa [orderedCount] using numbers
          have remainingReads : CoreDecode.ReadsPagesFrom source 2 remaining := by
            simpa [source] using CoreDecode.ReadsPagesFrom.ofList_append
              [schemaPage.bytes] remaining []
          have orderedReads : CoreDecode.ReadsPagesFrom source 2
              (ordered.map CorePageCodec.NumberedPage.page) := by
            exact CoreDecode.ReadsPagesFrom.left
              (right := indexPages) (by simpa [remaining] using remainingReads)
          have orderedContains : CorePageCodec.PageSourceContains source ordered :=
            CorePageCodec.PageSourceContains.ofReadsRange source 2 ordered
              orderedNumbers orderedReads
          have numberedContains :
              CorePageCodec.PageSourceContains source numbered := by
            intro page member
            apply orderedContains page
            apply List.mem_mergeSort.mpr
            unfold CoreWidePageCodec.includePendingBytePlaceholder
            split <;> simp_all
          have numberedLengthLe : numbered.length ≤ ordered.length := by
            simp [ordered, CorePageCodec.orderNumberedPages,
              CoreWidePageCodec.includePendingBytePlaceholder]
            split <;> simp
          have sourceCount : source.pageCount = 1 + remaining.length := by
            simp [source, CoreDecode.PageSource.ofList, Nat.add_comm]
          have tablesDecoded := decodeTablesFrom_encodeTables source state.tables
            numbered numberedResult numberedContains (by
              rw [sourceCount]
              simp only [remaining, List.length_append, List.length_map]
              omega)
            (fun table member =>
              CoreWidePageCodec.rowsInline_spec inlineResult table member)
          have tableList :
              state.tables.map (fun table => table.table.withoutIndexes) =
                database.tables.map Core.Table.withoutIndexes := by
            calc
              _ = (state.tables.map (fun table => table.table)).map
                    Core.Table.withoutIndexes := by
                  simp [List.map_map, Function.comp_def]
              _ = database.tables.map Core.Table.withoutIndexes := by
                  rw [state.tables_eq,
                    (CoreWidePageState.State.build?_represents stateResult).1]
          have tablesDecoded' :
              (tableEntries.map CoreDecode.CatalogEntry.ofEncoded).mapM
                  (CoreDecode.decodeTableFrom source) =
                some (database.tables.map Core.Table.withoutIndexes) := by
            unfold tableEntries
            simpa [List.map_map, Function.comp_def, tableList]
              using tablesDecoded
          have indexReads : CoreDecode.ReadsPagesFrom source state.nextPage
              indexPages := by
            have afterTables := CoreDecode.ReadsPagesFrom.right
              (left := ordered.map CorePageCodec.NumberedPage.page)
              (right := indexPages)
              (by simpa [remaining] using remainingReads)
            simpa [startEqual] using afterTables
          let indexNumbered := CoreWideIndex.numberedPagesOf indexEncodings
          have indexNumbers : indexNumbered.map
                CorePageCodec.NumberedPage.pageNumber =
              List.range' state.nextPage indexPages.length := by
            simpa [indexNumbered, indexPages] using
              CoreWideIndex.encodeIndexTableGroups_numbers state.nextPage
                database.tables indexEncodings indexResult
          have indexPageMap : indexNumbered.map
                CorePageCodec.NumberedPage.page = indexPages := by
            simpa [indexNumbered, indexPages] using
              (CoreWideIndex.indexPagesOf_eq_map indexEncodings).symm
          have indexNumberedLength : indexNumbered.length =
              indexPages.length := by
            have equal := congrArg List.length indexPageMap
            simpa using equal
          have indexNumbers' : indexNumbered.map
                CorePageCodec.NumberedPage.pageNumber =
              List.range' state.nextPage indexNumbered.length := by
            simpa [indexNumberedLength] using indexNumbers
          have indexNumberedReads : CoreDecode.ReadsPagesFrom source
              state.nextPage
              (indexNumbered.map CorePageCodec.NumberedPage.page) := by
            simpa [indexPageMap] using indexReads
          have allIndexesContain : CorePageCodec.PageSourceContains source
              indexNumbered :=
            CorePageCodec.PageSourceContains.ofReadsRange source
              state.nextPage indexNumbered indexNumbers' indexNumberedReads
          have individualIndexContains : ∀ encoding ∈ indexEncodings,
              CorePageCodec.PageSourceContains source
                encoding.numberedPages := by
            intro encoding member page pageMember
            apply allIndexesContain page
            unfold indexNumbered CoreWideIndex.numberedPagesOf
            simp only [List.mem_flatMap]
            exact ⟨encoding, member, List.mem_mergeSort.mpr pageMember⟩
          have individualIndexBound : ∀ encoding ∈ indexEncodings,
              encoding.numberedPages.length < source.pageCount + 1 := by
            intro encoding member
            have lengthBound :=
              CoreWideIndex.numberedPages_length_le_of_mem member
            unfold indexNumbered at indexNumberedLength
            rw [indexNumberedLength] at lengthBound
            have indexWithinRemaining : indexPages.length ≤
                remaining.length := by
              simp [remaining]
            rw [sourceCount]
            omega
          have indexesApplied :=
            CoreWideIndex.applyIndexesForOpen_encoded source database
              state.nextPage indexEncodings indexResult
              individualIndexContains individualIndexBound
          have indexesApplied' :
              CoreDecode.applyIndexesForOpen source database.withoutIndexes
                (indexEntries.map CoreDecode.CatalogEntry.ofEncoded) =
                  some database.canonicalize := by
            simpa [indexEntries, CoreWideIndex.indexEntriesOf, List.map_map,
              Function.comp_def] using indexesApplied
          have safe : ∀ entry ∈ entries,
              CoreDecode.CatalogTextRoundtrips entry := by
            intro entry _
            exact ⟨utf8 entry.kind, utf8 entry.name,
              utf8 entry.table, utf8 entry.sql⟩
          have catalogDecoded :=
            CoreDecode.decodeCatalogForOpen_schemaPageForEntries entries count
              safe schemaResult
          have tableFilter :
              ((entries.map CoreDecode.CatalogEntry.ofEncoded).filter
                (fun entry => entry.kind == "table")) =
                tableEntries.map CoreDecode.CatalogEntry.ofEncoded := by
            rw [show entries.map CoreDecode.CatalogEntry.ofEncoded =
                tableEntries.map CoreDecode.CatalogEntry.ofEncoded ++
                  indexEntries.map CoreDecode.CatalogEntry.ofEncoded by
              simp [entries]]
            rw [List.filter_append]
            have tablesKept :
                (tableEntries.map CoreDecode.CatalogEntry.ofEncoded).filter
                  (fun entry => entry.kind == "table") =
                    tableEntries.map CoreDecode.CatalogEntry.ofEncoded := by
              apply List.filter_eq_self.mpr
              intro entry member
              rcases List.mem_map.mp member with ⟨encodedEntry, encodedMember, rfl⟩
              rcases List.mem_map.mp encodedMember with ⟨table, _, rfl⟩
              rfl
            have indexesRemoved :
                (indexEntries.map CoreDecode.CatalogEntry.ofEncoded).filter
                  (fun entry => entry.kind == "table") = [] := by
              apply List.filter_eq_nil_iff.mpr
              intro entry member
              rcases List.mem_map.mp member with ⟨encodedEntry, encodedMember, rfl⟩
              rcases List.mem_map.mp encodedMember with ⟨encoding, _, rfl⟩
              simp [CoreWideIndex.IndexEncoding.catalogEntry,
                CoreDecode.CatalogEntry.ofEncoded]
            rw [tablesKept, indexesRemoved, List.append_nil]
          have indexFilter :
              ((entries.map CoreDecode.CatalogEntry.ofEncoded).filter
                (fun entry => entry.kind == "index")) =
                indexEntries.map CoreDecode.CatalogEntry.ofEncoded := by
            rw [show entries.map CoreDecode.CatalogEntry.ofEncoded =
                tableEntries.map CoreDecode.CatalogEntry.ofEncoded ++
                  indexEntries.map CoreDecode.CatalogEntry.ofEncoded by
              simp [entries]]
            rw [List.filter_append]
            have tablesRemoved :
                (tableEntries.map CoreDecode.CatalogEntry.ofEncoded).filter
                  (fun entry => entry.kind == "index") = [] := by
              apply List.filter_eq_nil_iff.mpr
              intro entry member
              rcases List.mem_map.mp member with ⟨encodedEntry, encodedMember, rfl⟩
              rcases List.mem_map.mp encodedMember with ⟨table, _, rfl⟩
              simp [CoreWidePageCodec.tableCatalogEntry,
                CoreDecode.CatalogEntry.ofEncoded]
            have indexesKept :
                (indexEntries.map CoreDecode.CatalogEntry.ofEncoded).filter
                  (fun entry => entry.kind == "index") =
                    indexEntries.map CoreDecode.CatalogEntry.ofEncoded := by
              apply List.filter_eq_self.mpr
              intro entry member
              rcases List.mem_map.mp member with ⟨encodedEntry, encodedMember, rfl⟩
              rcases List.mem_map.mp encodedMember with ⟨encoding, _, rfl⟩
              rfl
            rw [tablesRemoved, indexesKept, List.nil_append]
          have firstRead : source.readPage 1 = some schemaPage.bytes := by
            simp [source, CoreDecode.PageSource.ofList, CoreDecode.page?]
          refine .intro (entries.map CoreDecode.CatalogEntry.ofEncoded) ?_ ?_ ?_
          · rw [firstRead]
            simp only [Option.bind_eq_bind, Option.bind]
            exact catalogDecoded
          · rw [tableFilter]
            exact tablesDecoded'
          · rw [indexFilter]
            exact indexesApplied'
      next => contradiction
    next => contradiction
  next => contradiction

theorem pageSourceRepresents_encodeBulkInline
    (utf8 : CoreDecode.UTF8Roundtrips) (database : Core.Database)
    (image : CoreFile.Image)
    (encoded : CoreWidePageCodec.encodeBulkInline database = some image) :
    CoreDecode.PageSourceRepresents
      (.ofList (image.pages.map CoreFile.Page.bytes)) database := by
  unfold CoreWidePageCodec.encodeBulkInline at encoded
  cases resultEq : CoreWidePageCodec.encodeBulkInlineWithState database with
  | none => simp [resultEq] at encoded
  | some result =>
      rcases result with ⟨builtImage, state⟩
      simp only [resultEq, Option.map, Option.some.injEq] at encoded
      subst image
      exact pageSourceRepresents_encodeBulkInlineWithState utf8 database
        builtImage state resultEq

theorem decodeFromPageSource_encodeBulkInline
    (utf8 : CoreDecode.UTF8Roundtrips) (database : Core.Database)
    (image : CoreFile.Image)
    (encoded : CoreWidePageCodec.encodeBulkInline database = some image) :
    CoreDecode.decodeFromPageSource
      (.ofList (image.pages.map CoreFile.Page.bytes)) =

theorem encodeBulkInline_header {database : Core.Database}
    {image : CoreFile.Image}
    (encoded : CoreWidePageCodec.encodeBulkInline database = some image) :
    ∃ (count : FileFormat.U32Value) (schema : CoreFile.Page)
      (remaining : List CoreFile.Page) (body : List UInt8),
      image.pages = schema :: remaining ∧
      image.pageCount = count.val ∧
      schema.bytes = FileFormat.encodeDatabaseHeader
        (CoreFile.databaseHeader count) ++ body := by
  unfold CoreWidePageCodec.encodeBulkInline at encoded
  cases resultEq : CoreWidePageCodec.encodeBulkInlineWithState database with
  | none => simp [resultEq] at encoded
  | some result =>
    rcases result with ⟨builtImage, builtState⟩
    simp only [resultEq, Option.map, Option.some.injEq] at encoded
    subst image
    unfold CoreWidePageCodec.encodeBulkInlineWithState at resultEq
    rcases Option.bind_eq_some_iff.mp resultEq with ⟨state, stateResult, resultEq⟩
    split at resultEq
    next =>
      rcases Option.bind_eq_some_iff.mp resultEq with
        ⟨numbered, numberedResult, resultEq⟩
      dsimp only at resultEq
      split at resultEq
      next =>
        rcases Option.bind_eq_some_iff.mp resultEq with
          ⟨indexEncodings, indexResult, resultEq⟩
        split at resultEq
        next countBound =>
          let ordered := CorePageCodec.orderNumberedPages
            (CoreWidePageCodec.includePendingBytePlaceholder state.nextPage
              numbered)
          let entries := state.tables.map CoreWidePageCodec.tableCatalogEntry ++
            CoreWideIndex.indexEntriesOf indexEncodings
          let remaining := ordered.map CorePageCodec.NumberedPage.page ++
            CoreWideIndex.indexPagesOf indexEncodings
          let count : FileFormat.U32Value := ⟨1 + remaining.length, by
            have stronger : 1 + remaining.length + 1 < 2 ^ 32 := by
              simpa [remaining, ordered] using countBound
            omega⟩
          change (do
            let schema ← CoreFile.schemaPageForEntries? entries count
            some (⟨database, schema :: remaining⟩, state)) =
              some (builtImage, builtState) at resultEq
          cases schemaResult : CoreFile.schemaPageForEntries? entries count with
          | none => simp [schemaResult] at resultEq
          | some schema =>
            rw [schemaResult] at resultEq
            simp only [Option.bind_eq_bind, Option.bind, Option.some.injEq,
              Prod.mk.injEq] at resultEq
            rcases resultEq with ⟨imageEqual, stateEqual⟩
            subst builtImage
            rcases CoreFile.schemaPageForEntries_header schemaResult with
              ⟨body, header⟩
            refine ⟨count, schema, remaining, body, rfl, ?_, header⟩
            simp [CoreFile.Image.pageCount, count, Nat.add_comm]
        next => contradiction
      next => contradiction
    next => contradiction

/-- Whole-file left inverse for the high-fanout inline encoder. -/
theorem decode_encodeBulkInline (utf8 : CoreDecode.UTF8Roundtrips)
    (database : Core.Database) (image : CoreFile.Image)
    (encoded : CoreWidePageCodec.encodeBulkInline database = some image) :
    CoreDecode.decode image.fileBytes = some database.canonicalize := by
  rcases encodeBulkInline_header encoded with
    ⟨count, schema, remaining, body, pagesEqual, countEqual, headerEqual⟩
  have bytesLayout : image.fileBytes =
      FileFormat.encodeDatabaseHeader (CoreFile.databaseHeader count) ++
        (body ++ remaining.flatMap CoreFile.Page.bytes) := by
    unfold CoreFile.Image.fileBytes
    rw [pagesEqual]
    simp only [List.flatMap_cons]
    rw [headerEqual]
    simp [List.append_assoc]
  have fileLength : image.fileBytes.length =
      count.val * PhysicalCodec.pageSize := by
    rw [CoreFile.Image.fileBytes_length, countEqual, Nat.mul_comm]
  have splitPages : CoreDecode.pages count.val image.fileBytes =
      image.pages.map CoreFile.Page.bytes := by
    rw [← countEqual]
    exact CoreDecode.pages_image image
  unfold CoreDecode.decode
  rw [bytesLayout, FileFormat.decodeDatabaseHeader_encode]
  simp only [Option.bind_eq_bind, Option.bind]
  rw [show (CoreFile.databaseHeader count).databaseSizePages.val = count.val
    from rfl]
  rw [dif_pos (by rfl), dif_pos (by rfl), dif_pos (by rfl)]
  rw [← bytesLayout]
  rw [dif_pos fileLength, splitPages]
  exact decodeFromPageSource_encodeBulkInline utf8 database image encoded

end CoreWidePageInverse
end SQLeanite
SQLeanite/CoreData.lean:
import SQLeanite.ColumnDefault
import SQLeanite.PhysicalCodec
import SQLeanite.PhysicalQuery
import SQLeanite.PersistentPageTree
import SQLeanite.SQLite.PhysicalAffinity
import SQLeanite.SQLite.PrimaryKey
import Std.Data.TreeMap.Lemmas

namespace SQLeanite
namespace Core

-- Lean 4.35 requires the lexicographic product order to be selected explicitly.
attribute [local instance] lexOrd

abbrev Value := PhysicalCodec.Value
abbrev Integer := FileFormat.SignedInteger .eight

/-- Schema constraint policies supported by the atomic Core SQL boundary.
FAIL/ROLLBACK require a distinct statement outcome and are not represented yet. -/
inductive NotNullConflict where
  | abort | ignore | replace
  deriving DecidableEq, Repr

/-- The declared type of an indexed primary key, including absent versus
explicitly empty types. The legacy TEXT-key shape remains a compact case. -/
structure IndexedType where
  declaredType : String
  explicitEmptyType : Bool := false
  explicitEmptyTypeOnly : explicitEmptyType = true → declaredType = "" := by simp_all
  deriving DecidableEq, Repr

structure Column where
  name : String
  notNull : Bool := false
  integerPrimaryKey : Bool := false
  /-- Explicit SQL NOT NULL on an INTEGER rowid alias. `notNull` separately
  records the internal invariant that an allocated rowid is never NULL. -/
  integerPrimaryNotNull : Bool := false
  integerPrimaryNotNullOnly : integerPrimaryNotNull = true → integerPrimaryKey = true := by
    simp_all
  /-- A non-aliasing SQLite primary key. Unlike `INTEGER PRIMARY KEY`, this
  column remains in the record payload and is backed by an automatic index. -/
  textPrimaryKey : Bool := false
  /-- Non-primary declared type. Primary columns use INTEGER, the compact
  TEXT case, or their indexedType metadata. Keeping these cases disjoint makes
  canonical schema printing invertible for every admitted Column. -/
  declaredType : String := ""
  primaryType : (integerPrimaryKey || textPrimaryKey) = true → declaredType = "" := by
    simp_all
  notNullConflict : NotNullConflict := .abort
  notNullConflictOnly : notNullConflict ≠ .abort →
      notNull = true ∧ (integerPrimaryKey = true → integerPrimaryNotNull = true) := by
    simp_all
  primaryConflict : NotNullConflict := .abort
  primaryConflictOnly : primaryConflict ≠ .abort → (integerPrimaryKey || textPrimaryKey) = true := by
    simp_all
  defaultValue : Option ColumnDefault.Spec := none
  /-- An explicitly empty type has NUMERIC affinity; an absent type has BLOB.
The displayed type is empty in both cases. -/
  explicitEmptyType : Bool := false
  explicitEmptyTypeOnly : explicitEmptyType = true →
      declaredType = "" ∧ integerPrimaryKey = false ∧ textPrimaryKey = false := by simp_all
  indexedType : Option IndexedType := none
  indexedTypeOnly : indexedType.isSome = true → textPrimaryKey = true := by simp_all
  autoIncrement : Bool := false
  autoIncrementOnly : autoIncrement = true → integerPrimaryKey = true := by simp_all
  deriving DecidableEq, Repr

def Column.typed (name typeName : String) (notNull : Bool) : Column :=
  if typeName = "" then { name, notNull, explicitEmptyType := true }
  else { name, notNull, declaredType := typeName }

def Column.withPrimaryConflict (column : Column) (policy : NotNullConflict) : Option Column :=
  if valid : (column.integerPrimaryKey || column.textPrimaryKey) = true then
    some { column with primaryConflict := policy, primaryConflictOnly := fun _ => valid }
  else if policy = .abort then some column else none

def Column.withNotNullConflict (column : Column) (policy : NotNullConflict) : Option Column :=
  if valid : column.notNull = true ∧
      (column.integerPrimaryKey = true → column.integerPrimaryNotNull = true) then
    some { column with notNullConflict := policy, notNullConflictOnly := fun _ => valid }
  else if policy = .abort then some column else none

def Column.withoutNotNullConflict (column : Column) : Column :=
  { column with notNullConflict := .abort, notNullConflictOnly := by simp }

theorem Column.restoreNotNullConflict (column : Column) :
    column.withoutNotNullConflict.withNotNullConflict column.notNullConflict = some column := by
  unfold Column.withNotNullConflict Column.withoutNotNullConflict
  split
  · rfl
  · next invalid =>
      have plain : column.notNullConflict = .abort := by
        by_cases same : column.notNullConflict = .abort
        · exact same
        · exact False.elim (invalid (column.notNullConflictOnly same))
      simp [plain]
      cases column
      simp_all

def Column.affinity (column : Column) : SQLite.Affinity :=
  if column.integerPrimaryKey then .integer
  else if column.textPrimaryKey then
    match column.indexedType with
    | none => .text
    | some typ => if typ.explicitEmptyType then .numeric else SQLite.typeAffinity typ.declaredType
  else if column.explicitEmptyType then .numeric
  else SQLite.typeAffinity column.declaredType

/-- Explicitly empty declared types retain their numeric affinity independently
of column names and nullability; an omitted type has blob affinity instead. -/
theorem Column.typed_empty_affinity (name : String) (notNull : Bool) :
    (Column.typed name "" notNull).affinity = .numeric := by
  simp [Column.typed, Column.affinity]

def Column.defaultForInsert (column : Column) : Except String Value := do
  if column.integerPrimaryKey then return .null
  match column.defaultValue with
  | none => return .null
  | some spec => return SQLite.PhysicalAffinity.write column.affinity (← ColumnDefault.evaluate spec)

def Column.defaultForRecord (column : Column) : Except String Value := do
  match column.defaultValue with
  | none => return .null
  | some spec => return SQLite.PhysicalAffinity.write column.affinity (← ColumnDefault.storedValue spec)

theorem Column.defaultForInsert_rowid (column : Column) (key : column.integerPrimaryKey = true) :
    column.defaultForInsert = .ok .null := by simp [Column.defaultForInsert, key, pure, Except.pure]

structure Schema where
  name : String
  columns : List Column
  primaryKey : Nat
  /-- Column named by the user's PRIMARY KEY declaration. It differs from
  `primaryKey` when Core lowers a non-integer key or an implicit rowid.
  A value equal to columns.length means there is no declared primary key. -/
  declaredPrimaryKey : Nat := primaryKey
  deriving DecidableEq, Repr

def namesUnique (names : List String) : Prop :=
  names.Pairwise (· ≠ ·)

instance (names : List String) : Decidable (namesUnique names) :=
  inferInstanceAs (Decidable (names.Pairwise (· ≠ ·)))

def hiddenRowidColumn : Column := {
  name := "__sqleanite_rowid"
  notNull := true
  integerPrimaryKey := true }

def Schema.hasHiddenRowid (schema : Schema) : Bool :=
  schema.primaryKey != schema.declaredPrimaryKey

/-- AUTOINCREMENT belongs only to the actual INTEGER rowid alias. -/
def Schema.autoIncrement (schema : Schema) : Bool :=
  (schema.columns[schema.primaryKey]?).any (·.autoIncrement)

/-- Columns described by the public `CREATE TABLE` declaration. The internal
rowid-alias column is deliberately absent from this view. -/
def Schema.catalogColumns (schema : Schema) : List Column :=
  if schema.hasHiddenRowid then schema.columns.take schema.primaryKey
  else schema.columns

/-- Canonical rowid-table shapes supported by the proved file codec. A hidden
rowid represents either a declared TEXT key or a table without a declared key.
The latter uses columns.length as an out-of-range declared-key sentinel. -/
def Schema.CatalogShape (schema : Schema) : Prop :=
  if schema.hasHiddenRowid then
    schema.columns = schema.catalogColumns ++ [hiddenRowidColumn] ∧
    schema.primaryKey = schema.catalogColumns.length ∧
    schema.catalogColumns.findIdx? (·.integerPrimaryKey) = none ∧
    schema.catalogColumns ≠ [] ∧
    schema.declaredPrimaryKey =
      (schema.catalogColumns.findIdx? (·.textPrimaryKey)).getD schema.columns.length
  else
    schema.catalogColumns = schema.columns ∧
    schema.declaredPrimaryKey = schema.primaryKey ∧
    schema.catalogColumns.findIdx? (·.integerPrimaryKey) =
      some schema.primaryKey ∧
    schema.catalogColumns.findIdx? (·.textPrimaryKey) = none

instance (schema : Schema) : Decidable schema.CatalogShape := by
  unfold Schema.CatalogShape
  infer_instance

def Schema.WellFormed (schema : Schema) : Prop :=
  schema.primaryKey < schema.columns.length ∧
  (schema.columns[schema.primaryKey]?).any (·.integerPrimaryKey) ∧
  (schema.columns.filter (·.integerPrimaryKey)).length = 1 ∧
  namesUnique (schema.columns.map (·.name)) ∧
  schema.columns.findIdx? (·.integerPrimaryKey) = some schema.primaryKey ∧
  (∀ column ∈ schema.columns,
    column.integerPrimaryKey → column.notNull) ∧
  schema.CatalogShape

instance (schema : Schema) : Decidable schema.WellFormed := by
  unfold Schema.WellFormed namesUnique
  infer_instance

def Schema.visibleColumnIndices (schema : Schema) : List Nat :=
  (List.range schema.columns.length).filter fun index =>
    !(schema.primaryKey != schema.declaredPrimaryKey && index == schema.primaryKey)

def Schema.visibleColumns (schema : Schema) : List Column :=
  schema.visibleColumnIndices.filterMap fun index => schema.columns[index]?

/-- SQL declared-column names range over visible physical positions only.
The bookkeeping column of an implicit rowid is not a declared SQL name. -/
def Schema.declaredColumn? (schema : Schema) (name : String) : Option Nat :=
  schema.visibleColumnIndices.find? fun index =>
    (schema.columns[index]?).any (fun column => column.name.toLower == name.toLower)

theorem Schema.declaredColumn_visible (schema : Schema) (name : String) (index : Nat)
    (found : schema.declaredColumn? name = some index) :
    index ∈ schema.visibleColumnIndices :=
  List.mem_of_find?_eq_some found

/-- Declared columns shadow SQLite's three implicit rowid spellings. -/
def Schema.column? (schema : Schema) (name : String) : Option Nat :=
  match schema.declaredColumn? name with
  | some index => some index
  | none => if ["rowid", "oid", "_rowid_"].contains name.toLower then
      some schema.primaryKey else none

theorem Schema.column_visible_or_rowid (schema : Schema) (name : String) (index : Nat)
    (found : schema.column? name = some index) :
    index ∈ schema.visibleColumnIndices ∨
      (["rowid", "oid", "_rowid_"].contains name.toLower = true ∧ index = schema.primaryKey) := by
  cases declared : schema.declaredColumn? name with
  | some position =>
      have equal : position = index := by simpa [Schema.column?, declared] using found
      exact Or.inl (schema.declaredColumn_visible name index (equal ▸ declared))
  | none =>
      simp only [Schema.column?, declared] at found
      split at found
      next alias => exact Or.inr ⟨alias, (Option.some.inj found).symm⟩
      next => cases found

def Schema.declaredPrimaryKey? (schema : Schema) : Option Nat :=
  schema.columns[schema.declaredPrimaryKey]?
    |>.map fun _ => schema.declaredPrimaryKey

theorem Schema.findIdx?_column_name (schema : Schema)
    (wellFormed : schema.WellFormed) (index : Nat)
    (bound : index < schema.columns.length) :
    schema.columns.findIdx?
      (fun candidate => candidate.name = schema.columns[index].name) = some index := by
  rw [List.findIdx?_eq_some_iff_getElem]
  refine ⟨bound, ?_, ?_⟩
  · simp
  · intro earlier earlierLt
    have earlierBound : earlier < schema.columns.length := Nat.lt_trans earlierLt bound
    have earlierNamesBound :
        earlier < (schema.columns.map (·.name)).length := by simpa
    have indexNamesBound :
        index < (schema.columns.map (·.name)).length := by simpa
    have unique := List.pairwise_iff_getElem.mp wellFormed.2.2.2.1
      earlier index earlierNamesBound indexNamesBound earlierLt
    simpa using unique

structure Index where
  name : String
  column : Nat
  unique : Bool := false
  deriving DecidableEq, Repr

def Index.isImplicitPrimary (schema : Schema) (index : Index) : Bool :=
  schema.hasHiddenRowid &&
    index.name == "sqlite_autoindex_" ++ schema.name ++ "_1" &&
    index.column == schema.declaredPrimaryKey && !index.unique

def Index.WellFormed (schema : Schema) (index : Index) : Prop :=
  index.column < schema.columns.length

/-- SQLite identifiers may be empty. An index's local invariant is its column
bound; distinct names are checked separately for the complete index list. -/
theorem Index.wellFormed_rename (schema : Schema) (index : Index) (name : String) :
    ({ index with name } : Index).WellFormed schema ↔ index.WellFormed schema := Iff.rfl

instance (schema : Schema) (index : Index) : Decidable (index.WellFormed schema) :=
  by unfold Index.WellFormed; infer_instance

structure Row where
  rowid : Integer
  values : List Value
  deriving DecidableEq

/-- A comparison key which retains every bit of a SQLite value.  `compareOn`
this key gives the balanced-map implementation a transitive total comparison
without collapsing distinct storage classes or payloads. -/
def Value.orderKey : Value → Nat × (Option Int × (Option Nat ×
    (Option (List UInt8) × Option (List UInt8))))
  | .null => (0, none, none, none, none)
  | .integer value => (1, some value.value, none, none, none)
  | .realBits bits => (2, none, some bits.val, none, none)
  | .text value => (3, none, none, some value.bytes, none)
  | .blob value => (4, none, none, none, some value.bytes)

theorem Value.orderKey_injective : ∀ ⦃left right : Value⦄,
    left.orderKey = right.orderKey → left = right := by
  intro left right equal
  cases left <;> cases right <;> simp_all [Value.orderKey]
  case integer.integer left right =>
    cases left
    cases right
    simp_all
  case realBits.realBits left right =>
    cases left
    cases right
    simp_all
  case text.text left right =>
    cases left
    cases right
    simp_all
  case blob.blob left right =>
    cases left
    cases right
    simp_all

theorem Value.compareOn_orderKey_eq {left right : Value} :
    compareOn Value.orderKey left right = .eq ↔ left = right := by
  simp only [compareOn, Std.compare_eq_iff_eq]
  exact ⟨fun equal => Value.orderKey_injective equal,
    congrArg Value.orderKey⟩

def columnAccepts (column : Column) (value : Value) : Prop :=
  (column.notNull = true → value ≠ .null) ∧
    SQLite.PhysicalAffinity.accepts column.affinity value = true

instance (column : Column) (value : Value) : Decidable (columnAccepts column value) :=
  by unfold columnAccepts; infer_instance

def columnAcceptsBool (column : Column) (value : Value) : Bool :=
  (!column.notNull || value != .null) && SQLite.PhysicalAffinity.accepts column.affinity value

theorem columnAcceptsBool_iff (column : Column) (value : Value) :
    columnAcceptsBool column value = true ↔ columnAccepts column value := by
  unfold columnAcceptsBool columnAccepts
  cases notNull : column.notNull <;> simp_all

theorem columnRead_eq_self {column : Column} {value : Value}
    (accepted : columnAcceptsBool column value = true) :
    SQLite.PhysicalAffinity.read column.affinity value = value :=
  SQLite.PhysicalAffinity.read_eq_self ((columnAcceptsBool_iff _ _).mp accepted).2

theorem columnComparison_eq_self {column : Column} {value : Value}
    (accepted : columnAcceptsBool column value = true) :
    SQLite.PhysicalAffinity.comparison column.affinity value = value :=
  SQLite.PhysicalAffinity.comparison_eq_self ((columnAcceptsBool_iff _ _).mp accepted).2

def readColumnValues : List Column → List Value → List Value
  | column :: columns, value :: values =>
      SQLite.PhysicalAffinity.read column.affinity value :: readColumnValues columns values
  | _, values => values

theorem readColumnValues_eq_self (columns : List Column) (values : List Value)
    (accepted : (columns.zip values).all (fun pair => columnAcceptsBool pair.1 pair.2) = true) :
    readColumnValues columns values = values := by
  induction columns generalizing values with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons column columns induction =>
      cases values with
      | nil => rfl
      | cons value values =>
          simp only [List.zip_cons_cons, List.all_cons, Bool.and_eq_true] at accepted
          simp only [readColumnValues, columnRead_eq_self accepted.1, induction values accepted.2]

def Row.WellFormed (schema : Schema) (row : Row) : Prop :=
  row.values.length = schema.columns.length ∧
  row.values[schema.primaryKey]? = some (.integer row.rowid) ∧
  (schema.columns.zip row.values).all
    (fun pair => columnAcceptsBool pair.1 pair.2) = true

instance (schema : Schema) (row : Row) : Decidable (row.WellFormed schema) :=
  by unfold Row.WellFormed; infer_instance

def Row.declaredPrimaryValue? (schema : Schema) (row : Row) : Option Value := do
  let column ← schema.declaredPrimaryKey?
  row.values[column]?

/-- Row identities occupy a different namespace from stored SQL values.
This keeps nullable numeric primary keys disjoint from every NULL row. -/
inductive DeclaredKey where
  | rowid (identifier : Integer)
  | value (payload : Value)
  deriving DecidableEq

def DeclaredKey.orderKey : DeclaredKey → Bool × (Nat × (Option Int × (Option Nat ×
    (Option (List UInt8) × Option (List UInt8)))))
  | .rowid integer => (false, Value.orderKey (.integer integer))
  | .value payload => (true, payload.orderKey)

theorem DeclaredKey.orderKey_injective {left right : DeclaredKey}
    (equal : left.orderKey = right.orderKey) : left = right := by
  cases left with
  | rowid left =>
      cases right with
      | rowid right =>
          simp only [DeclaredKey.orderKey, Prod.mk.injEq, true_and] at equal
          have values := Value.orderKey_injective equal
          cases values
          rfl
      | value right => simp [DeclaredKey.orderKey] at equal
  | value left =>
      cases right with
      | rowid right => simp [DeclaredKey.orderKey] at equal
      | value right =>
          simp only [DeclaredKey.orderKey, Prod.mk.injEq, true_and] at equal
          exact congrArg DeclaredKey.value (Value.orderKey_injective equal)

theorem DeclaredKey.compareOn_orderKey_eq {left right : DeclaredKey} :
    compareOn DeclaredKey.orderKey left right = .eq ↔ left = right := by
  simp only [compareOn, Std.compare_eq_iff_eq]
  exact ⟨DeclaredKey.orderKey_injective, congrArg DeclaredKey.orderKey⟩

def Row.declaredKey (schema : Schema) (row : Row) : DeclaredKey :=
  match row.declaredPrimaryValue? schema with
  | none | some .null => .rowid row.rowid
  | some key => .value (SQLite.PrimaryKey.canonical key)

theorem Row.declaredKey_null (schema : Schema) (row : Row)
    (nullKey : row.declaredPrimaryValue? schema = some .null) :
    row.declaredKey schema = .rowid row.rowid := by
  simp [Row.declaredKey, nullKey]

theorem Row.declaredKey_null_injective (schema : Schema) (left right : Row)
    (leftNull : left.declaredPrimaryValue? schema = some .null)
    (rightNull : right.declaredPrimaryValue? schema = some .null) :
    left.declaredKey schema = right.declaredKey schema ↔ left.rowid = right.rowid := by
  rw [Row.declaredKey_null schema left leftNull, Row.declaredKey_null schema right rightNull]
  simp

theorem Row.declaredKey_nonnull (schema : Schema) (row : Row) (key : Value)
    (present : row.declaredPrimaryValue? schema = some key) (nonnull : key ≠ .null) :
    row.declaredKey schema = .value (SQLite.PrimaryKey.canonical key) := by
  cases key <;> simp_all [Row.declaredKey]

theorem Row.declaredKey_null_ne_nonnull (schema : Schema) (left right : Row) (key : Value)
    (leftNull : left.declaredPrimaryValue? schema = some .null)
    (rightValue : right.declaredPrimaryValue? schema = some key) (nonnull : key ≠ .null) :
    left.declaredKey schema ≠ right.declaredKey schema := by
  rw [Row.declaredKey_null schema left leftNull, Row.declaredKey_nonnull schema right key rightValue nonnull]
  simp

theorem Row.declaredKey_no_declared (schema : Schema) (row : Row)
    (absent : schema.declaredPrimaryKey? = none) :
    row.declaredKey schema = .rowid row.rowid := by
  simp [Row.declaredKey, Row.declaredPrimaryValue?, absent]

abbrev DeclaredKeyMap :=
  Std.TreeMap DeclaredKey Row (compareOn DeclaredKey.orderKey)

def buildDeclaredKeyMap (schema : Schema) (rows : List Row) :
    DeclaredKeyMap :=
  if schema.hasHiddenRowid then
    rows.foldr (fun row (map : DeclaredKeyMap) =>
      map.insert (row.declaredKey schema) row) ∅
  else ∅

theorem buildDeclaredKeyMap_get_of_hidden (schema : Schema) (rows : List Row)
    (key : DeclaredKey) (hidden : schema.hasHiddenRowid = true) :
    (buildDeclaredKeyMap schema rows).get? key =
      rows.find? (fun row => row.declaredKey schema == key) := by
  unfold buildDeclaredKeyMap
  rw [if_pos hidden]
  induction rows with
  | nil => simp
  | cons row rows induction =>
      simp only [List.foldr_cons]
      change ((rows.foldr
        (fun row (map : DeclaredKeyMap) =>
          map.insert (row.declaredKey schema) row) ∅).insert
          (row.declaredKey schema) row)[key]? = _
      rw [Std.TreeMap.getElem?_insert]
      simp only [DeclaredKey.compareOn_orderKey_eq, beq_iff_eq]
      change (rows.foldr
        (fun row (map : DeclaredKeyMap) =>
          map.insert (row.declaredKey schema) row) ∅)[key]? = _
        at induction
      by_cases same : row.declaredKey schema = key <;>
        simp [same, induction]

def DeclaredKeyMapRepresents (schema : Schema) (rows : List Row)
    (map : DeclaredKeyMap) : Prop :=
  schema.hasHiddenRowid = true → ∀ key,
    map.get? key = rows.find? (fun row => row.declaredKey schema == key)

theorem buildDeclaredKeyMap_represents (schema : Schema) (rows : List Row) :
    DeclaredKeyMapRepresents schema rows
      (buildDeclaredKeyMap schema rows) := by
  intro hidden key
  exact buildDeclaredKeyMap_get_of_hidden schema rows key hidden

def Row.keyLess (left right : Row) : Prop :=
  left.rowid.value < right.rowid.value

instance (left right : Row) : Decidable (Row.keyLess left right) :=
  by unfold Row.keyLess; infer_instance

/-- Bias a signed 64-bit integer into the natural key space without changing
order. This is the routing key shared by logical rows, persisted index rowids,
and the primary tree. -/
def Integer.treeKey (integer : Integer) : Nat :=
  (integer.value + Int.ofNat FileFormat.IntegerWidth.eight.midpoint).toNat

def Row.treeKey (row : Row) : Nat := row.rowid.treeKey

theorem Integer.treeKey_int (integer : Integer) :
    Int.ofNat integer.treeKey =
      integer.value + Int.ofNat FileFormat.IntegerWidth.eight.midpoint := by
  unfold Integer.treeKey
  exact Int.toNat_of_nonneg (by
    have lower := integer.lowerBound
    omega)

theorem Integer.treeKey_eq_iff (left right : Integer) :
    left.treeKey = right.treeKey ↔ left.value = right.value := by
  constructor
  · intro equal
    have coerced := congrArg Int.ofNat equal
    rw [left.treeKey_int, right.treeKey_int] at coerced
    omega
  · intro equal
    unfold Integer.treeKey
    rw [equal]

theorem Row.treeKey_int (row : Row) :
    Int.ofNat row.treeKey =
      row.rowid.value + Int.ofNat FileFormat.IntegerWidth.eight.midpoint := by
  exact row.rowid.treeKey_int

theorem Row.treeKey_lt_iff (left right : Row) :
    left.treeKey < right.treeKey ↔ left.rowid.value < right.rowid.value := by
  constructor
  · intro less
    have coerced : Int.ofNat left.treeKey < Int.ofNat right.treeKey :=
      Int.ofNat_lt.mpr less
    rw [left.treeKey_int, right.treeKey_int] at coerced
    omega
  · intro less
    apply Int.ofNat_lt.mp
    change Int.ofNat left.treeKey < Int.ofNat right.treeKey
    rw [left.treeKey_int, right.treeKey_int]
    omega

theorem Row.treeKey_eq_iff (left right : Row) :
    left.treeKey = right.treeKey ↔ left.rowid.value = right.rowid.value := by
  exact Integer.treeKey_eq_iff left.rowid right.rowid

def treeEntries (rows : List Row) :
    List (RecursiveBPlusTree.Entry Row) :=
  rows.map fun row => (row.treeKey, row)

theorem treeEntries_sorted {rows : List Row}
    (sorted : rows.Pairwise Row.keyLess) :
    PagedBTree.KeysStrictlySorted (treeEntries rows) := by
  unfold treeEntries PagedBTree.KeysStrictlySorted
  change (rows.map fun row => (row.treeKey, row)).Pairwise
    (fun left right : Nat × Row => left.1 < right.1)
  apply List.pairwise_map.mpr
  exact sorted.imp fun less => (Row.treeKey_lt_iff _ _).2 less

def IndexesWellFormed (schema : Schema) (indexes : List Index) : Prop :=
  (∀ index ∈ indexes, index.WellFormed schema) ∧
  namesUnique (indexes.map (·.name))

instance (schema : Schema) (indexes : List Index) :
    Decidable (IndexesWellFormed schema indexes) := by
  unfold IndexesWellFormed namesUnique Index.WellFormed
  infer_instance

def RowsWellFormed (schema : Schema) (rows : List Row) : Prop :=
  (∀ row ∈ rows, row.WellFormed schema) ∧ rows.Pairwise Row.keyLess

/-- A linear-time decision form of `RowsWellFormed`.  Checking every pair in
an ordered row list made validation quadratic even though integer order is
transitive.  Adjacent comparisons carry exactly the same information. -/
def RowsWellFormedAdjacent (schema : Schema) : List Row → Prop
  | [] => True
  | [row] => row.WellFormed schema
  | row :: next :: rows =>
      row.WellFormed schema ∧ Row.keyLess row next ∧
        RowsWellFormedAdjacent schema (next :: rows)

def decideRowsWellFormedAdjacent (schema : Schema) :
    (rows : List Row) → Decidable (RowsWellFormedAdjacent schema rows)
  | [] => isTrue trivial
  | [row] => by
      exact inferInstanceAs (Decidable (row.WellFormed schema))
  | row :: next :: rows =>
      let rowValid : Decidable (row.WellFormed schema) := inferInstance
      let ordered : Decidable (Row.keyLess row next) := inferInstance
      let tail := decideRowsWellFormedAdjacent schema (next :: rows)
      @instDecidableAnd (row.WellFormed schema)
        (Row.keyLess row next ∧ RowsWellFormedAdjacent schema (next :: rows))
        rowValid
        (@instDecidableAnd (Row.keyLess row next)
          (RowsWellFormedAdjacent schema (next :: rows)) ordered tail)
termination_by rows => rows.length

instance (schema : Schema) (rows : List Row) :
    Decidable (RowsWellFormedAdjacent schema rows) :=
  decideRowsWellFormedAdjacent schema rows

theorem Row.keyLess_trans {first second third : Row}
    (left : Row.keyLess first second) (right : Row.keyLess second third) :
    Row.keyLess first third := by
  exact Int.lt_trans left right

private theorem keyLess_all_of_cons {first second : Row} {rows : List Row}
    (head : Row.keyLess first second)
    (tail : (second :: rows).Pairwise Row.keyLess) :
    ∀ row ∈ second :: rows, Row.keyLess first row := by
  intro row member
  rcases List.pairwise_cons.mp tail with ⟨secondBefore, _⟩
  simp only [List.mem_cons] at member
  cases member with
  | inl equal => simpa [equal] using head
  | inr later =>
      exact Row.keyLess_trans head (secondBefore row later)

theorem rowsWellFormedAdjacent_iff (schema : Schema) (rows : List Row) :
    RowsWellFormedAdjacent schema rows ↔ RowsWellFormed schema rows := by
  induction rows with
  | nil => simp [RowsWellFormedAdjacent, RowsWellFormed]
  | cons row rows induction =>
      cases rows with
      | nil => simp [RowsWellFormedAdjacent, RowsWellFormed]
      | cons next rows =>
          constructor
          · intro adjacent
            rcases adjacent with ⟨rowValid, head, tailAdjacent⟩
            have tail := induction.mp tailAdjacent
            refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
            · intro candidate member
              simp only [List.mem_cons] at member
              cases member with
              | inl equal => simpa [equal] using rowValid
              | inr later => exact tail.1 candidate (by simpa using later)
            · exact List.pairwise_cons.mpr
                ⟨keyLess_all_of_cons head tail.2, tail.2⟩
          · intro wellFormed
            rcases wellFormed with ⟨allValid, ordered⟩
            rcases List.pairwise_cons.mp ordered with ⟨rowBefore, tailOrdered⟩
            refine ⟨allValid row (by simp), rowBefore next (by simp), ?_⟩
            apply induction.mpr
            exact ⟨fun candidate member =>
              allValid candidate (by simp [member]), tailOrdered⟩

instance (schema : Schema) (rows : List Row) :
    Decidable (RowsWellFormed schema rows) :=
  decidable_of_iff (RowsWellFormedAdjacent schema rows)
    (rowsWellFormedAdjacent_iff schema rows)

def storedRows (tree : PersistentPageTree.Store Row) : List Row :=
  tree.root.erase.toList.map (fun entry => entry.2)

def RowTreeWellKeyed (tree : PersistentPageTree.Store Row) : Prop :=
  tree.Represents (treeEntries (storedRows tree))

end Core
end SQLeanite

import SQLeanite.CoreSchemaSQL

/-! Catalog text is observable database content. A retained source carries a
checked relation to its schema; arbitrary SQL cannot be attached to a table.
Canonical sources have a unique empty representation so encoding and decoding
remain exact, including the optional source metadata. -/
namespace SQLeanite.CoreCatalogSQL

def parse (sql : String) : Option Core.Schema :=
  match CanonicalSchemaSQL.parse sql with
  | some schema => some schema
  | none => CoreSchemaSQL.tableSchema sql

theorem parse_print (schema : Core.Schema)
    (printable : CanonicalSchemaSQL.Printable schema) :
    parse (CanonicalSchemaSQL.print schema) = some schema := by
  unfold parse CanonicalSchemaSQL.print CanonicalSchemaSQL.parse
  rw [String.toList_ofList,
    CanonicalSchemaSQL.parseChars_tableChars schema printable]

structure Source (schema : Core.Schema) where
  text : String
  decoded : parse text = some schema
  noncanonical : text ≠ CanonicalSchemaSQL.print schema

def retain (schema : Core.Schema) (text : String)
    (decoded : parse text = some schema) : Option (Source schema) :=
  if equal : text = CanonicalSchemaSQL.print schema then none
  else some ⟨text, decoded, equal⟩

def text (schema : Core.Schema) (source : Option (Source schema)) : String :=
  match source with
  | none => CanonicalSchemaSQL.print schema
  | some source => source.text

theorem parse_text (schema : Core.Schema)
    (printable : CanonicalSchemaSQL.Printable schema)
    (source : Option (Source schema)) :
    parse (text schema source) = some schema := by
  cases source with
  | none => exact parse_print schema printable
  | some source => exact source.decoded

theorem text_retain (schema : Core.Schema) (sql : String)
    (decoded : parse sql = some schema) :
    text schema (retain schema sql decoded) = sql := by
  unfold retain
  split
  next equal => exact equal.symm
  next => rfl

theorem retain_text (schema : Core.Schema) (source : Option (Source schema))
    (decoded : parse (text schema source) = some schema) :
    retain schema (text schema source) decoded = source := by
  cases source with
  | none => simp [retain, text]
  | some source => simp [retain, text, source.noncanonical]

end SQLeanite.CoreCatalogSQL

import SQLeanite.CoreData
import SQLeanite.SQLite.ColumnType

namespace SQLeanite
namespace CoreSQL

def unsupported (feature : String) : Except String α :=
  .error s!"unsupported general verified-MVP SQL: {feature}"

def canonical (name : String) : String := name.toLower

/-- Exact public type spelling after SQLite's standard-type normalization. -/
def declaredTypeName := SQLite.ColumnType.name

def ordinaryColumn (definition : ColumnDef) : Core.Column :=
  if (SQLite.ColumnType.adjusted definition.declaredType).isEmpty then
    { name := definition.name, notNull := definition.notNull }
  else Core.Column.typed definition.name (declaredTypeName definition.declaredType) definition.notNull

def columnAllowed (column : ColumnDef) : Bool :=
  SQLite.ColumnType.valid column.declaredType &&
  (column.defaultValue.isSome == column.defaultSql.isSome) &&
  column.generated.isNone && !column.unique &&
  column.references.isNone && column.check.isNone && (!column.autoIncrement || column.primaryKey) &&
  column.collation.toLower == "binary" &&
  (column.conflict == .abort || column.conflict == .ignore || column.conflict == .replace) &&
  (column.primaryKey || column.conflict == .abort) &&
  (column.notNullConflict == .abort || column.notNullConflict == .ignore || column.notNullConflict == .replace) &&
  (column.notNull || column.notNullConflict == .abort)

def columnWithConflicts (definition : ColumnDef) (column : Core.Column) : Except String Core.Column := do
  let policy ← match definition.notNullConflict with
    | .abort => pure Core.NotNullConflict.abort
    | .ignore => pure Core.NotNullConflict.ignore
    | .replace => pure Core.NotNullConflict.replace
    | _ => unsupported "schema NOT NULL conflict policy"
  let column ← match column.withNotNullConflict policy with
    | some column => pure column
    | none => unsupported "NOT NULL policy without an explicit constraint"
  let primary ← match definition.conflict with
    | .abort => pure Core.NotNullConflict.abort
    | .ignore => pure Core.NotNullConflict.ignore
    | .replace => pure Core.NotNullConflict.replace
    | _ => unsupported "schema PRIMARY KEY conflict policy"
  let column ← match column.withPrimaryConflict primary with
    | some column => pure column
    | none => unsupported "primary policy without a PRIMARY KEY constraint"
  for (_, source) in definition.earlierDefaults do
    unless (ColumnDefault.fromSource source).isSome do unsupported "earlier DEFAULT expression"
  match definition.defaultSql with
  | none => return column
  | some source =>
      let some spec := ColumnDefault.fromSource source | unsupported "DEFAULT expression"
      return { column with defaultValue := some spec }

/-- Mark a table-level key without changing column order, names or other
column constraints. The caller validates that its target exists uniquely. -/
def markPrimaryColumn (name : String) (definitions : Array ColumnDef) (conflict : ConflictAction := .abort)
    (autoIncrement : Bool := false) : Array ColumnDef :=
  definitions.map fun column =>
    if canonical column.name == canonical name then { column with primaryKey := true, conflict, autoIncrement }
    else column

theorem markPrimaryColumn_size (name : String) (definitions : Array ColumnDef) (conflict : ConflictAction := .abort)
    (autoIncrement : Bool := false) :
    (markPrimaryColumn name definitions conflict autoIncrement).size = definitions.size := by
  simp [markPrimaryColumn]

theorem markPrimaryColumn_names (name : String) (definitions : Array ColumnDef) (conflict : ConflictAction := .abort)
    (autoIncrement : Bool := false) :
    (markPrimaryColumn name definitions conflict autoIncrement).toList.map (·.name) = definitions.toList.map (·.name) := by
  simp only [markPrimaryColumn, Array.toList_map, List.map_map]
  apply List.map_congr_left
  intro column _
  simp only [Function.comp_apply]
  split <;> rfl

/-- Single-column table keys lower to the same Core key as column declarations.
Unlike column-level INTEGER PRIMARY KEY DESC, table-level DESC still aliases
the rowid in SQLite. Its index-only collation/direction therefore has no effect.
TEXT keys require the admitted ascending BINARY index representation. -/
def tablePrimaryColumns (definitions : Array ColumnDef)
    (constraints : Array TableConstraintDef) : Except String (Array ColumnDef) :=
  match constraints.toList with
  | [] => .ok definitions
  | [constraint] => do
      unless constraint.primaryKey && constraint.columns.size == 1 &&
          constraint.check.isNone &&
          (constraint.conflict == .abort || constraint.conflict == .ignore || constraint.conflict == .replace) do
        unsupported "table constraint"
      unless constraint.collations.size == 1 && constraint.descending.size == 1 do
        unsupported "table key metadata width"
      if definitions.any (·.primaryKey) then throw "table has more than one primary key"
      let name := constraint.columns[0]!
      let column ← match definitions.toList.find? (fun column => canonical column.name == canonical name) with
        | some column => .ok column
        | none => .error s!"no such column: {name}"
      let integerAlias := SQLite.ColumnType.standard column.declaredType == some "INTEGER"
      unless integerAlias || (!constraint.descending[0]! &&
          constraint.collations[0]!.all (fun name => canonical name == "binary")) do
        unsupported "table key index collation or direction"
      return markPrimaryColumn name definitions constraint.conflict constraint.autoIncrement
  | _ => unsupported "multiple table constraints"

theorem tablePrimaryColumns_empty (definitions : Array ColumnDef) :
    tablePrimaryColumns definitions #[] = .ok definitions := rfl

def schema (name : String) (definitions : Array ColumnDef)
    (constraints : Array TableConstraintDef) : Except String Core.Schema := do
  let definitions ← tablePrimaryColumns definitions constraints
  unless definitions.toList.all columnAllowed do
    throw "unsupported general verified-MVP SQL: column constraint"
  let foldedNames := definitions.toList.map (fun column => canonical column.name)
  unless foldedNames.eraseDups.length == foldedNames.length do
    throw "duplicate column name"
  let primaryKeys := definitions.toList.filter (·.primaryKey)
  if primaryKeys.isEmpty then
    let visibleColumns ← definitions.toList.mapM fun column => columnWithConflicts column (ordinaryColumn column)
    unless !visibleColumns.isEmpty do throw "table must have at least one column"
    if visibleColumns.any (fun column => canonical column.name == "__sqleanite_rowid") then
      throw "reserved verified column name: __sqleanite_rowid"
    return {
      name := name
      columns := visibleColumns ++ [Core.hiddenRowidColumn]
      primaryKey := visibleColumns.length
      declaredPrimaryKey := visibleColumns.length + 1 }
  unless primaryKeys.length = 1 do
    throw "verified MVP tables require exactly one PRIMARY KEY"
  let primaryKey ← match definitions.findIdx? (fun column => column.primaryKey) with
    | some index => .ok index
    | none => .error "verified MVP table has no primary key"
  let primaryDefinition ← match definitions[primaryKey]? with
    | some column => .ok column
    | none => .error "verified MVP primary-key index is out of bounds"
  let integerAlias := SQLite.ColumnType.standard primaryDefinition.declaredType == some "INTEGER"
  unless !primaryDefinition.autoIncrement || integerAlias do
    throw "AUTOINCREMENT is only allowed on an INTEGER PRIMARY KEY"
  let ordinary := ordinaryColumn primaryDefinition
  let indexedType : Core.IndexedType := {
    declaredType := ordinary.declaredType, explicitEmptyType := ordinary.explicitEmptyType,
    explicitEmptyTypeOnly := fun present => (ordinary.explicitEmptyTypeOnly present).1 }
  let visibleColumns ← definitions.toList.mapM fun column => columnWithConflicts column <|
    if column.primaryKey then {
      name := column.name
      notNull := integerAlias || column.notNull
      integerPrimaryKey := integerAlias
      integerPrimaryNotNull := integerAlias && column.notNull
      autoIncrement := integerAlias && column.autoIncrement
      autoIncrementOnly := fun present => (Bool.and_eq_true_iff.mp present).1
      textPrimaryKey := !integerAlias
      indexedType := if integerAlias || indexedType.declaredType == "TEXT" then none else some indexedType
      indexedTypeOnly := by
        split
        · simp
        · next custom => simp_all }
    else ordinaryColumn column
  if integerAlias then return {
    name := name
    columns := visibleColumns
    primaryKey
    declaredPrimaryKey := primaryKey }
  else
    let hiddenName := "__sqleanite_rowid"
    if visibleColumns.any (fun column => canonical column.name == hiddenName) then
      throw s!"reserved verified column name: {hiddenName}"
    return {
      name := name
      columns := visibleColumns ++ [Core.hiddenRowidColumn]
      primaryKey := visibleColumns.length
      declaredPrimaryKey := primaryKey }

def indexColumnName? : Expr → Option String
  | .column none name => some name
  | .call "lean_dqs" #[.literal (.text name)] false => some name
  | .call "__sqlean_boolean_true" #[] false => some "true"
  | .call "__sqlean_boolean_false" #[] false => some "false"
  | _ => none

end CoreSQL
end SQLeanite
